Job Summary and Responsibilities

The JPC Department Manager is responsible for the day-to-day management and performance of Joint Pole Committee (JPC) services within the Wireless SoCal department. This position leads department personnel, monitors production and quality, tracks customer and milestone requirements, manages JPA-related documentation and billing activities, prepares customer deliverables, and supports the JPC Director and customer representatives. The role serves as a key point of coordination for Joint Pole Association (JPA) activities, including disputed or denied transactions, committee requirements, and customer reporting.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES include the following. Other duties may be assigned:

  • Perform all duties and responsibilities associated with the JPA Department Manager role and provide subject-matter guidance to department personnel as needed.
  • Manage all JPC services on a day-to-day basis, ensuring department personnel meet required productivity, quality, schedule, documentation, and customer-service expectations.
  • Monitor and record Field Inspector production, output, quality levels, and related performance data; identify trends, deficiencies, and required corrective actions.
  • Track and report monthly production and completion volumes for all applicable milestones and service activities performed by the department.
  • Track additional JPA/JPC requirements, metrics, documentation, and customer-specific activities as requested by the Customer.
  • Prepare, review, and submit required customer deliverables, reports, trackers, supporting documentation, and milestone records accurately and on schedule.
  • Manage Form 44 billing activities in accordance with contract requirements, including validation of supporting documentation, milestone completion, and billing readiness.
  • Support the JPC Director and Customer Representatives with program execution, reporting, issue resolution, escalations, and special requests.
  • Manage JPA denials and maintain complete documentation for contested, disputed, or conflicting JPA transactions; coordinate research, responses, and escalation as required.
  • Attend and/or represent the Customer at applicable JPC meetings, providing project status, documentation, follow-up, and coordination as required.
  • Maintain accurate department records and ensure JPA/JPC activities are documented in applicable customer and internal systems.
  • Coordinate with field personnel, project teams, utilities, Joint Pole Associations/Committees, and customer stakeholders to resolve issues and keep work progressing.
  • Provide day-to-day leadership, workload prioritization, coaching, and performance support to assigned department personnel.
  • Identify operational risks, recurring issues, process gaps, and opportunities to improve quality, efficiency, reporting, and customer service.

SAFETY DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Adhere to, promote, and accept personal responsibility for compliance to:

Federal and Local Occupational Safety and Health Regulations

Industry Consensus Standards

Circet USA Injury and Illness Prevention Program Manual

  • Participate in job site safety/hazard analysis

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Project Management, Telecommunications, Engineering, Construction Management, or a related field; or a minimum of five (5) years of relevant industry experience in lieu of a degree. Relevant experience should include Joint Pole Association (JPA), Joint Pole Committee (JPC), utility, pole attachment, wireless telecommunications, or related infrastructure programs. A minimum of two years of project management, team leadership, or supervisory experience is preferred.
  • Working knowledge of JPA/JPC processes, pole attachment requirements, utility coordination, field inspection activities, milestone tracking, denials, contested transactions, and supporting documentation.
  • Experience managing field personnel, vendors, subcontractors, or multi-functional project teams and holding resources accountable for productivity, quality, schedule, and customer requirements.
  • Demonstrated ability to interpret contracts, customer requirements, utility/JPA documentation, billing requirements, technical records, and related project documentation.
  • Experience preparing customer deliverables, production reports, performance metrics, milestone tracking, and documentation used to support billing and program reporting.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage and interface with customers, utilities, Joint Pole Associations/Committees, field personnel, project teams, and other internal and external stakeholders.
  • Must possess successful project and process-management experience, including the ability to identify workflow gaps, resolve issues, manage competing priorities, and improve operational efficiency.
  • Demonstrated ability to forecast workload, monitor production and quality, manage program performance, and support financially successful projects in accordance with contractual requirements.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to prepare clear documentation, lead meetings, present status and issues, and professionally represent the Customer when required.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and the ability to learn and effectively use customer and internal project-management, tracking, and reporting systems.

Job Summary

Communications Products Specialist Sr, Operational Informatics Pipeline (OIP)

Job Summary:

Aptive seeks a Communications Products Specialist Sr to support the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Veterans Health Administration (VHA) Office of Clinical Informatics (OCI) on the Operational Informatics Pipeline (OIP) contract. You will plan, write, and produce the communications that help clinicians, informaticists, and partners understand and adopt OCI’s informatics work, from newsletters and web content to deployment messaging and outreach materials. The role supports both the Interoperability and Clinical Informatics Solutions specialty areas, including health information exchange outreach, Electronic Health Record (EHR) adoption, and the Health Informatics Community of Practice that reaches VA medical centers nationwide. You will work within Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) Agile Release Trains alongside clinical informaticists, change management specialists, and VA Business Owners.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Communications Planning. Develop communication plans and calendars for informatics initiatives, tailored to clinical, operational, and partner audiences.
  • Information Products. Write, edit, and produce newsletters, fact sheets, web and SharePoint content, briefings, infographics, and other information products.
  • Community of Practice Channels. Manage content for the Health Informatics Community of Practice and related channels that distribute guidance to VA medical centers.
  • Interoperability Outreach. Develop outreach and education materials that promote health information exchange with Veterans, community providers, and industry partners.
  • EHR Adoption Communications. Develop deployment messaging and adoption materials that support Federal EHR site transitions, VistA/CPRS changes, and ongoing reinforcement of effective EHR use.
  • Workforce Engagement. Develop communications that support informatics workforce, training, and engagement programs.
  • Media and Public Affairs Support. Draft press materials, talking points, and responses to information requests for Government review and release.
  • Social Media and Digital Channels. Draft and schedule content for internal and approved social media channels, and track engagement.
  • Accessibility and Standards. Ensure products meet Section 508 accessibility, plain-language, and VA branding standards.
  • Measurement. Track reach and engagement of communications and recommend improvements.
  • Agile Team Participation. Participate in Planning Interval (PI) Planning, iteration ceremonies, and system demos; align communications timelines with Feature delivery.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree (BA/BS) required.
  • Minimum of 8 years of professional experience in communications, public relations, or a related field.
  • Experience writing, editing, and producing information products, such as newsletters, web content, press materials, or briefings.
  • Experience managing communication channels, including internal communications or social media.
  • Experience writing for varied audiences, including senior leaders and technical or clinical staff.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a VA background investigation at the level assigned to the position; must reside and work in the United States with U.S. work authorization.

Desired Qualifications

  • Degree in communications, journalism, public relations, or a related field.
  • Experience with communications for VA, VHA, or another federal health care organization.
  • Experience communicating health IT or EHR changes to clinicians.
  • Experience with SharePoint, Teams, and design tools, such as Adobe Creative Suite or Canva.
  • Experience applying Section 508 accessibility and plain-language standards.
  • Experience supporting change management communications; Prosci certification.
  • Experience on SAFe or Scrum teams.

About Aptive. Aptive partners with federal agencies to achieve their missions through improved performance, streamlined operations and enhanced service delivery. Based in Alexandria, Virginia, we support more than a dozen agencies including Veterans Affairs, Transportation, Defense, Homeland Security and the National Science Foundation. We specialize in applying technology, creativity and human-centered services to optimize mission delivery and improve experiences for millions of people who count on government services every day. Founded: 2012. Employees: 300+ nationwide.

Job Title: Director, Supplier Transfer PMO

Job Description Summary

The Director, Supplier Transfer PMO will lead a global organization of approximately 30 professionals responsible for executing supplier transfer programs across GE HealthCare. This is a transformational leadership role focused on building a best-in-class PMO that accelerates supplier transfers while ensuring quality, regulatory, operational, and business requirements are met.

The role combines strategic leadership, organizational development, and execution excellence to deliver business outcomes including cost productivity, supply continuity, risk reduction, capacity expansion, and supplier resiliency. Success requires influencing senior leaders, driving organizational change, developing talent, and leading enterprise-wide transformation through Lean principles, digital technologies, and standardized operating frameworks.

GE Healthcare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our mission is to improve lives in the moments that matter. Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world.

Job Description

Roles and Responsibilities

Enterprise Leadership

  • Lead and develop a global team of approximately 30 employees across multiple regions.
  • Establish and lead the Global Supplier Transfer PMO, driving execution excellence across the enterprise portfolio.
  • Lead organizational transformation, capability building, and operating model development to establish a best-in-class organization.
  • Drive talent management, succession planning, workforce development, and leadership coaching to build a strong leadership pipeline.
  • Develop scalable supplier transfer processes, governance models, and operating mechanisms.
  • Own portfolio prioritization, resource allocation, risk management, and executive reporting.

Program Execution

  • Drive disciplined project execution, milestone management, risk mitigation, and issue resolution.
  • Leverage digital tools and automation to improve visibility, resource planning, and decision making.

PMO Governance & Performance

  • Drive data-based decision making through portfolio reviews, visual management, and standardized reporting.
  • Ensure consistent execution through milestone reviews, risk management, and escalation processes.
  • Track and deliver business outcomes related to cost, resiliency, supply continuity, capacity, and growth.

Transformation & Continuous Improvement

  • Champion Lean principles and continuous improvement across the supplier transfer lifecycle.
  • Lead process simplification, standardization, digitization, and automation initiatives.
  • Drive organizational effectiveness, employee engagement, and adoption of new ways of working.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, Business, or related field.
  • 10+ years of leadership experience in program management, sourcing, manufacturing, operations, supply chain, or transformation organizations.
  • Proven success leading large global teams and developing high-performing organizations.
  • Experience leading complex cross-functional initiatives that deliver measurable business results.
  • Experience building PMOs, governance frameworks, KPI systems, and executive dashboards.
  • Demonstrated success leading organizational transformation, change management, and operating model evolution.
  • Strong executive presence with the ability to influence stakeholders in a global matrixed environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's degree (MBA or technical discipline).
  • Lean Six Sigma Black Belt or equivalent certification.
  • Experience leading supplier transfers, sourcing transformations, PMOs, or large-scale operational change initiatives.
  • Experience leading organizations of 25+ employees across multiple regions.
  • Experience in talent management, organizational design, leadership development, and change management.
  • Experience in healthcare, medical devices, aerospace, or other regulated industries.
  • Experience using digital technologies, analytics, and automation to improve business performance.

Desired Characteristics

  • Transformational leader with a passion for building world-class organizations.
  • Strong organizational development, talent management, and leadership coaching skills.
  • Lean thinker with a focus on simplification, scalability, and operational excellence.
  • Data-driven leader who leverages metrics to drive accountability and performance.
  • Exceptional stakeholder management, communication, and influencing skills.
  • Proven ability to lead change while delivering sustained business results.

We expect all employees to live and breathe our behaviors: to act with humility and build trust; lead with transparency; deliver with focus, and drive ownership –always with unyielding integrity.

Our total rewards are designed to unlock your ambition by giving you the boost and flexibility you need to turn your ideas into world-changing realities. Our salary and benefits are everything you’d expect from an organization with global strength and scale, and you’ll be surrounded by career opportunities in a culture that fosters care, collaboration and support.

Job Title: Cyber Security Engineer
Location: USA (Remote)
FLSA Status: FTE
Reports To: Manager, Security Engineering – Cyber Threat Team

Job Summary:

We are seeking a Security Engineer with a solid programming foundation to help automate and strengthen our global cybersecurity operations. Working alongside senior engineers, this role will focus on building scripts, automations, and reporting that streamline incident response, vulnerability management, and security monitoring. This is a growth-oriented position: you will develop hands-on expertise in enterprise security platforms and automation engineering while contributing to the organization's overall security posture. The ideal candidate’s background includes programming or scripting experience and an interest in cybersecurity.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain scripts and automations that improve security processes within security-oriented platforms and other IT platforms, with guidance from senior engineers.
  • Assist senior engineers in building and maintaining integrations between security tools and platforms.
  • Develop dashboards, reports, and technical documentation for stakeholders to track security operations deliverables, trends, and progress on security posture.
  • Support incident response and other security operations tasks through automation.
  • Learn and apply DevOps and agile practices as part of the security engineering team.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related field, and 5 years of relevant work experience.
  • Ability to write and debug Python code; academic projects, internships, or personal projects all count.
  • Familiarity with version control (e.g. Git).
  • General cybersecurity knowledge from coursework, labs, or certifications is preferred.
  • Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills.
  • Eagerness to learn and the ability to collaborate across global teams and time zones.

Nice to Have:

  • Internship, co-op, or project experience in security, IT, or software development.
  • Exposure to SIEM/SOAR platforms (e.g. Palo Alto Cortex XSIAM) or ITSM tools (e.g., ServiceNow).
  • Familiarity with security concepts such as MITRE ATT&CK, threat intelligence, or vulnerability management.
  • Exposure to DevOps tools and practices.

Preferred Certifications:

  • CompTIA Security+
  • CompTIA CySA+
  • Other relevant security or cloud certifications (e.g. AWS Security Specialty, Azure Security Engineer)

jobs.excerpt: Position DescriptionValiant Solutions is seeking a Senior Enterprise Security Architect to join our rapidly growing and innovative cybersecurity team!
jobs.description:
Position Description

Valiant Solutions is seeking a Senior Enterprise Security Architect to join our rapidly growing and innovative cybersecurity team!

The Senior Enterprise Security Architect will lead the development of security architecture guidance, standards, and reference diagrams for on-premise and cloud platforms and systems. This is an exciting role to support both macro and micro security design for a large government agency. You’ll get to support a variety of cloud and on-premise projects. This position requires a deep level of understanding of a variety of commercial and government frameworks, such as OWASP and NIST Special Publications used to secure federal systems. This knowledge must be combined with experience designing and assessing security architectures for both cloud and on-premise systems to protect the confidentiality, availability, and integrity of systems and their data using COTS tools, cloud native services, and component-level configuration settings. In this role, you will lead from the front as the key subject matter expert guiding our valued client. The successful candidate will support the design of enterprise security architectures and their associated guidance.

U.S. Citizenship is required due to federal contract obligations, along with the ability to successfully pass a federal background investigation. Must be able to obtain and maintain a Public Trust.

Named one of the Best Places to Work in the Washington DC area for 12 consecutive years, Valiant is proud of our employee-centric culture and commitment to excellence. If you are interested in learning more about Valiant and this opportunity, we invite you to apply now!

This position allows for 100% remote work. Remote work necessitates a high-level trust in our employees and we strictly adhere to the details found below in our Remote Work Policy.

Required Experience

  • 7+ years of experience designing security architectures by referencing NIST security controls, agency policy, and government-wide security requirements. This experience must include the design of on-premise and cloud security fabrics for all layers of the system (application down to CSP).
  • 2+ years of experience designing Zero Trust Architectures to secure cloud and on-premise systems
  • Experience designing security architectures hosted in Microsoft Azure, using a combination of Azure-native services and COTS tooling
  • Experience assessing/reviewing security architectures, writing reports with detailed explanatory findings, and providing briefings on your findings.
  • Developing security architecture guidance to include policy language, Standard Operating Procedures, and as-code hardening standards.
  • Extensive knowledge of NIST 800- 53rev5 and other NIST Special Publications.
  • Current knowledge of government-wide security mandates and CISA Directives
  • Ability to define and document system security boundaries and categorize systems based on security and privacy requirements.
  • Skilled in analyzing user needs to inform and guide secure architecture planning.
  • Proven ability to assess and evaluate enterprise security postures and identify impacts from new systems or interfaces.
  • Experience developing technical documentation, including written documents and diagrams.
  • Experience developing presentation slide decks and presenting to technical and non-technical personnel.
  • Experience identifying and documenting system and organizational security and privacy requirements, including personal data handling.
  • Familiarity with identifying and protecting enterprise and system-level security data.
  • Ability to collaborate with stakeholders and translate functional needs into technical security requirements.
  • Ability to support cost estimation and technical guidance related to secure system design and changes.
  • Skilled in identifying gaps in security architecture and contributing to the development of security risk management plans.
  • Proficiency in documenting and updating security architecture throughout the system development and acquisition lifecycle.

Preferred Relevant Certifications:

  • CompTIA Advanced Security Practitioner (CASP)
  • CompTIA Cloud Essentials
  • Comptia Cloud+
  • Comptia Security+
  • EC-Council Certified Network Defense Architect (CNDA)
  • EC-Council Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH)
  • GIAC Continuous Monitoring Certification (GMON)
  • GIAC Security Expert (GSE)
  • ISC2 Certified Cloud Security Professional (CCSP)
  • ISC2 Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)
  • ISC2 CISSP Information Systems Security Architecture Professional (CISSP-ISSAP)
  • ISC2 CISSP Information Systems Security Engineering Professional (CISSP-ISSEP)
  • ISC2 Systems Security Certified Practitioner (SSCP)

Responsibilities

  • Develop and align system security architectures with organizational cybersecurity guidelines, including defining security boundaries, documenting system categorization, and analyzing user needs and requirements.
  • Develop focused guidance for specific security mechanisms such as encryption for data at rest
  • Assess and evaluate security postures, reviewing candidate architectures, identifying protection needs, and determining how new systems or interfaces impact enterprise security.
  • Identify and document security and privacy requirements, including types of personal information, stakeholder interests, and data that require protection, ensuring proper allocation at both system and organizational levels.
  • Support acquisition and procurement efforts by providing input on security requirements for statements of work, project costs, and translating proposed capabilities into technical specifications.
  • Contribute to risk management and compliance, performing architecture reviews, identifying security gaps, supporting RMF activities, and maintaining documentation throughout the acquisition lifecycle.
  • Provide high-quality technical, engineering, analytical, and planning support to meet the organization's requirements.
  • Perform architectural review and analysis, developing strategic enterprise solutions that address the evolving business requirements and changing cybersecurity threat landscape.
  • Develop and deliver reports (e.g., reference architectures, white papers, roadmaps, architecture risk analysis) to facilitate the following, including but not limited to:
    • Define and develop security architecture and engineering standards
    • Develop business use cases and design patterns to articulate the organization's goals and objectives
    • Document the current “as-is” through a holistic review of the agency enterprise
    • Develop an envisioned target “to-be” based on the agency's needs and threat models
    • Assess the gaps between “as-is” and “to-be”, and provide roadmaps to close gaps.
    • Develop baselines and reference architectures consistent with standard frameworks
    • Perform Architect Risk Analysis (ARA) through systematic and comprehensive reviews
    • Identify, integrate, mature, and communicate key concepts that define continued direct interaction with the agency’s technical and operational leadership.
    • Identify, frame, and support the resolution of critical issues impacting the organization.
    • Update artifacts periodically to meet regulatory, audit, and compliance requirements.

About Valiant Solutions

Valiant Solutions is a security-focused IT solutions provider with public clients nationwide. Named one of the fastest growing privately held companies by Inc. 5000, Washington Technology’s Fast 50, and Washington Business Journal’s Best Places to Work in the D.C. area, Valiant Solutions prides itself on providing its employees with great benefits and career development opportunities. As a company, we are just as committed to growing careers as we are to building world-class IT solutions, all while enjoying an unparalleled work-life balance. We are in a phase of tremendous growth and building the team that will take us to the next level. We seek people whose talents and accomplishments will contribute to a thriving company, who have the character to support their capacity, and can make a positive impact on our culture. Alongside our talented team, you’ll learn to think quickly on your feet and expand your own personal and professional skill set. Our management team will inspire you to consider new perspectives and challenge you to become a better practitioner in the fast-paced industry of IT security.   • 3+ years of Splunk administration or engineering experience.
  • Proficiency in configuring and managing Splunk inputs, setting up data ingestion pipelines, and establishing system connections.
  • Knowledge of Splunk's Search Processing Language (SPL), data parsing techniques, and the use of regular expressions for data extraction and transformation.

  • Conduct regular Splunk Enterprise upgrades for deployment servers, heavy forwarders, and syslog servers.

  • TWF Earned Equity Ladder: Tier 2 (1-3% equity) eligible at month 6 against the 5-gate evaluation
  • Tier 3 (3-8% equity) progression by month 18 if you continue performing and take on strategic ownership
  • Tier 4 (8-15% equity, true partner level) by month 36 for the right person

  • The math: 8-15 signed engagements in Y1 at $40,000 to $80,000 average annualized retainer puts the division near its ARR target and puts you in Tier 2 equity range by month 6

Our Mission

Our mission is to SAVE AND IMPROVE LIVES BY EMPOWERING HEALTHCARE CONSUMERS. Come be part of remarkable.

Overview

How You Can Make a Difference

HealthEquity administers HSAs, FSAs, HRAs, COBRA, and commuter benefits, and our service operations exist to deliver a remarkable experience for our members. The Director, Demand Planning and Worforce Operations leads the consolidated Forecasting and Workforce Management pillar within the Workforce Strategy organization. This leader owns the end-to-end demand-to-delivery cycle: long-range and short-range demand forecasting, capacity and headcount planning, scheduling, and real-time operations across internal teams and BPO partner sites.

This is not a day-to-day execution role. The role is accountable for strategic direction, decision-ready insight for executives, capability-building across the team, and leading the organization through significant platform and operating-model change, including the Verint, Webex, and Amazon Connect migrations, and skill-based routing readiness.

What you will be doing

Forecasting and planning

  • Own the enterprise contact demand forecast (topline, LOB, and interval level) and translate it into capacity plans, hiring plans, and budget inputs for internal and BPO operations.
  • Model and communicate expected outcomes, including service level, ASA, occupancy, and cost to serve, across scenarios; quantify risks and opportunities to support leadership decisions.
  • Lead planning for seasonal peak (Q4/Q1), new partner ramps, and channel expansion (chat, skill-based routing), with clear assumptions and contingency plans.

Workforce management operations

  • Direct scheduling, real-time queue management, and intraday performance across internal and outsourced sites, with tamper-clear audit of adherence and performance data.
  • Drive WFM platform modernization: Verint migration (scheduling, RTQM automation, outcome projection) and readiness for Webex and Amazon Connect capabilities.
  • Expand WFM scope beyond member and client services as automation matures.

Leadership and capability building

  • Deliver executive communication and decision-ready reporting: concise narratives, clear recommendations, and quantified trade-offs rather than raw data.
  • Perform and coach data analysis and interpretation beyond standard reporting, connecting operational signals to financial and member-experience outcomes.
  • Coach and build capability across analysts and managers; operate with a strengths-based, empowerment-oriented leadership style.
  • Lead change management and adoption for new tools, processes, and operating models, including BPO partners.
  • Continuously assess team skill gaps and bring build / train / hire recommendations to leadership.
  • Align the pillar's work to long-term organizational priorities and future-state capability needs, including the lean 2027 operating model.

What success looks like in the first 12 months

  • Forecast accuracy and capacity-plan reliability targets met and reported transparently each cycle.
  • Verint migration adopted with measurable scheduling and RTQM automation gains; Q4 2026 / Q1 2027 peak delivered within service-level and cost commitments.
  • Analyst and manager bench strengthened through coaching, with documented skill-gap assessment and a build / train / hire plan in execution.
  • Executive forums receive decision-ready insight with clear recommendations, reducing escalation and rework.

What you'll need to be successful

Required

  • 10+ years in contact center forecasting, capacity planning, and workforce management, including 5+ years leading leaders in a multi-site environment with BPO partners.
  • Demonstrated ownership of enterprise-level demand forecasting and headcount/budget planning, with strong statistical and scenario-modeling skills.
  • Hands-on depth with WFM and telephony platforms (e.g., Verint or equivalent; Cisco/Webex; cloud contact center platforms) and experience leading platform migrations.
  • Proven executive communication: able to distill complex analysis into clear recommendations for VP+ audiences.
  • Track record of change leadership, coaching, and building high-performing analytical teams.

Preferred

  • Experience in healthcare, benefits administration, or another regulated environment with strict data-handling obligations.
  • Experience with skill-based routing design, chat/digital channel planning, and outsourcing governance.
  • Advanced analytics or data science exposure (SQL, Python/R, or BI platforms) sufficient to lead and quality-check analyst work.

Salary Range

$127000.00 To $160000 / year

Benefits & Perks

The actual compensation offer is determined based on job-related knowledge, education, skills, experience, and work location. This position will be eligible for performance-based incentives and restricted stock units as part of the total compensation package, in addition to a full range of benefits including:

  • Medical, dental, and vision
  • HSA contribution and match
  • Dependent care FSA match
  • Uncapped paid time off
  • Paid parental leave
  • 401(k) match
  • Personal and healthcare financial literacy programs
  • Ongoing education & tuition assistance
  • Gym and fitness reimbursement
  • Wellness program incentives

Onboarding & Travel

This is a remote role, with an in-person onboarding training component. New team members must participate in Trailhead, HealthEquity’s immersive onboarding experience Trailhead is designed to foster meaningful connections, support your integration into the organization, and equip you with a strong understanding of our business. Trailhead participation is a key expectation of this role. Trailhead is held onsite at our headquarters once per quarter. HealthEquity covers all required travel and accommodations.

This role may begin with a virtual, self-paced onboarding experience, followed by a mandatory onsite Trailhead session at a later date.

HealthEquity is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to team members with qualifying disabilities. Should you be selected for this role and require an accommodation, we will put you in touch with our Benefits Team so you can begin the accommodation request process.

Why work with HealthEquity

HealthEquity has a vision that by 2030 we will make HSAs as wide-spread and popular as retirement accounts. We are passionate about providing a solution that allows American families to connect health and wealth. Join us and discover a work experience where the person is valued more than the position. Click here to learn more.

You belong at HealthEquity!

HealthEquity, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer, and we are committed to being an employer where no matter your background or identity – you feel welcome and included. We ensure equal opportunity for all applicants and employees without regard to race, age, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, status as a qualified individual with a disability, veteran status, or other legally protected characteristics. HealthEquity is a drug-free workplace. For more information about our EEO policy, or about HealthEquity’s applicant disability accommodation, drug-free-workplace, background check, and E-Verify policies, please visit our Careers page.

About the role

Aptive Resources is hiring a coding supervisor to lead its remote coding team supporting Veterans Affairs medical centers across VISN 7. You'll be the main contact for the VA's HIMS staff, manage coder quality and productivity, and make sure every facility receives accurate, on-time work. Across eight facilities, the team will handle about 260,000 coded encounters a year.

Primary Responsibilities

What you'll do

  • Act as the main point of contact for the VA's HIMS supervisors and coding leads, and be available at least during Charleston VA Medical Center business hours (Eastern Time).
  • Assign work to coders and track it against each facility's turnaround times. Notify the VA by the second business day if a deadline is at risk.
  • Run ongoing quality reviews of at least 5% of all coded data (ICD-10-CM/PCS, CPT, DRGs, and abstracted data), track results by coder, and send weekly results to each facility.
  • Write corrective action plans and coach coders when accuracy falls below 95%.
  • Answer coder questions about unclear documentation, and escalate them to VA contacts when needed.
  • Manage re-reviews of records the VA questions before billing and responses to claim denials.
  • Help prepare monthly progress reports, quarterly summary reports, and kickoff materials such as work plans, staff rosters, and training records.
  • Train coders on VA policies, VHA coding guidelines, and VistA and CPRS workflows, and track mandatory VA training and background investigations.
  • Plan for staffing changes, including a two-week overlap when a coder is reassigned.

Minimum Qualifications

Required qualifications

  • An active RHIA, RHIT, CCS, CCS-P, CPC, or CPC-H credential.
  • At least 3 years of coding experience, plus supervisory, lead, or QA experience.
  • Strong knowledge of inpatient and outpatient coding, including ICD-10-CM/PCS, CPT, HCPCS, DRGs, E/M, and NCCI edits.
  • Completion of an accredited coding, HIM, or health information technician program.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills for working with VA leaders and clinicians.
  • US citizenship, and the ability to pass a federal background investigation (NACI) and fingerprinting.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience in VA or VHA HIMS, including VistA, CPRS, PTF, PCE, and Integrated Billing.
  • Experience managing a remote coding team across multiple facilities.
  • A coding auditing or QA background.

Additional requirements

  • Complete the VA's annual Privacy and Information Security Awareness and HIPAA training (TMS 10176 and 10203).
  • Aptive provides the laptop, encoder, and reference materials.

Arrow ARC supports Veterans Health Administration facilities and offices across the U.S. with health care staffing and program support via the 10-year Integrated Critical Staffing Program (ICSP). We provide staffing solutions to address critical shortages in VHA medical facilities caused by turnover, recruitment issues, seasonal needs, surges or emergencies.

Arrow is a certified Service-Disabled, Veteran-Owned Small Business joint venture between Artemis ARC and Aptive Resources, two award-winning companies that share an agile, mission-focused, results driven approach in the federal sector.​ Arrow provides management consulting services and specializes in working with federal government agencies like the Department of Veterans Affairs and Office of Personnel Management.​

Fyfe's Power & Electrification Division partners with major energy developers and infrastructure clients to deliver large-scale renewable energy and power infrastructure projects across Australia. Based in the Philippines, you will work remotely as part of an integrated project team, contributing to greenfield developments and the upgrade and expansion of existing networks that support Australia's energy transition.

As a Senior Electrical Designer, you will play a key role in the design and delivery of Electrical Balance of Plant (EBOP) projects for wind farms, solar farms and BESS developments, while also supporting HV transmission and distribution infrastructure. You will collaborate virtually with experienced engineers and designers across Australia and the Philippines, gaining exposure to a broad range of technical disciplines and some of Australia's most significant energy projects.

This permanent work-from-home role offers exposure to HV substations, switchyards, underground and overhead reticulation systems, grid connection infrastructure and utility coordination activities. You will contribute to complex technical projects in a supportive team environment, with regular online collaboration across locations and time zones.

Please note: This position is open to candidates residing in the Philippines. The successful candidate will be employed locally through a third-party employment agency and will work exclusively with Fyfe's Power & Electrification Division.

The Impact You'll Have

  • Deliver high-quality electrical design documentation for HV substations, utility infrastructure and renewable energy projects.
  • Develop primary design deliverables including equipment layouts, cable routing, earthing systems, conduit layouts and detailed construction drawings.
  • Support the successful coordination and delivery of multidisciplinary design packages to meet project and client requirements.
  • Contribute to HV and LV power system designs, equipment selection and technical solutions for complex energy infrastructure projects.
  • Collaborate with engineers and project teams to enhance design quality, project delivery and technical outcomes.
  • Help shape the delivery of renewable energy, transmission and power infrastructure projects that support Australia's evolving energy sector.

What You'll Bring

We are looking for an experienced Senior Electrical Designer based in the Philippines who is comfortable working remotely with Australian project teams, solving complex technical challenges and delivering high-quality outcomes across a diverse portfolio.

  • A bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a closely related discipline from a recognised institution.
  • 8+ years' experience within a design consultancy environment.
  • Strong experience in HV substation design and detailed design delivery using MicroStation and AutoCAD.
  • Experience delivering electrical engineering designs across renewable energy, transmission, substations, power generation, hydrogen, oil & gas or related energy sectors.
  • Proven capability undertaking LV and HV power generation and distribution systems design, including equipment selection such as transformers, circuit breakers and associated electrical infrastructure.
  • Experience completing HV and LV power system studies including load flow, short circuit, cable sizing, arc flash, discrimination and protection, earthing and harmonics assessments.
  • Proficiency using electrical modelling software such as ETAP, EMTP or PSCAD.

  • Strong written and verbal English communication, organisational and problem-solving skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively in a remote, cross-border team.
  • Previous experience supporting Australian projects or working to Australian Standards is highly regarded.

It would be great if you also have experience in High Voltage and Low Voltage Switchboard design in accordance with AS 61439 and exposure to instrumentation and control systems.

Why Fyfe?

Fyfe is an Australian multidisciplinary consultancy with more than 700 people across engineering, environment, planning and surveying. We partner with clients across the Energy & Resources and Property & Infrastructure sectors to deliver high-quality, commercially pragmatic solutions with a strong focus on client service and project delivery

Joining Fyfe from the Philippines means becoming a valued member of an international team, not an outsourced support function. Your expertise will have a genuine impact as you work on meaningful Australian energy projects and collaborate directly with experienced professionals across multiple disciplines.

Reasons to join Fyfe:

  • Regular collaboration with experienced colleagues across Australia and the Philippines.

jobs.excerpt: OverviewCherre is now a RealPage company, expanding our ability to deliver innovative data and technology solutions that transform the real estate industry.
jobs.description:
Overview

Cherre is now a RealPage company, expanding our ability to deliver innovative data and technology solutions that transform the real estate industry. Join us as we build what’s next together.

Cherre is the leading real estate data management and analytics platform. We connect, resolve, and organize the fragmented data real estate organizations rely on: internal systems, public records, and third-party providers, into a single, connected source of truth. Institutional investors, asset managers, and brokers use Cherre to power underwriting, portfolio management, and reporting on data they can trust.

Our work sits at the intersection of real estate domain knowledge and modern data infrastructure, and this role is central to how we translate that platform into value for our most strategic clients.

Responsibilities

We're looking for a Senior Director of Solutions Architecture to lead the domain-first solutions engine of our sales and delivery motion. You'll own the presales function end to end, from first discovery call through handoff into delivery. You'll manage and grow a team of Solution Architects and Business Analysts, and you'll set the vision for how we scope, demonstrate, and win.

This role rests first on deep real assets domain expertise, complemented by technical acumen and a strong market-facing presence. You'll be credible discussing property operations and investment strategy with a client's leadership, guiding the solution alongside their data and engineering teams, and representing Cherre in front of a prospect's decision-makers. Domain fluency is the foundation; the ideal candidate pairs it with enough technical depth and executive presence to carry a solution from discovery through the deal.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You'll be in the room for our most strategic deals, shaping how we translate complex prospect requirements into compelling, credible solutions. Just as important, you'll be expected to modernize how the function operates. We want a leader who builds tools and AI-assisted workflows that make the team faster and sharper, not one who simply runs the existing playbook.

  • Lead the domain engine. Understand each client’s business deeply and align solutions to achieve their objectives.
  • Lead the presales function. Own the full presales lifecycle and partner closely with Sales to drive technical wins on strategic and enterprise opportunities.
  • Manage and develop the team. Hire, coach, and grow a team of Solution Architects and Business Analysts. Set standards, build expertise, balance workloads across active deals, and foster a culture of technical rigor.
  • Drive scoping and discovery. Personally lead scoping and discovery for strategic prospects, uncovering requirements, identifying risks, and defining solutions that map to real business outcomes.
  • Own the RFP process. Run the RFP response process end to end, ensuring responses are accurate, differentiated, and delivered on time.
  • Ensure clean handoffs to Delivery. Build and maintain a repeatable bridge from presales scoping into implementation so nothing is lost between the sale and the build.
  • Modernize the function with AI. Design and build skills and agentic workflows, and optimize the agentic fleet to streamline the process from scoping through delivery. Continuously identify ways to use AI to improve the quality and speed of the team’s output.
  • Represent the point of view. Publish, speak, and advocate for Cherre’s perspective on real assets data and semantic infrastructure, shaping how the market thinks about the problem—not just how Cherre solves it.
  • Close the loop into Product. Translate market and client signals from the field into product roadmap input, ensuring the roadmap reflects what the market is actually telling you—not just what has already been scoped.

Qualifications

  • Real assets domain expertise spanning the full stack: up into the capital stack (fund structures, debt and equity vehicles, investment vehicles) and down into the physical, operational asset (property operations, leasing, maintenance, tenant and resident experience). A track record of scoping and designing solutions that hold together across both ends of that stack, not just one.
  • Global and cross-asset-class experience: comfortable moving between multifamily, office, industrial, retail, and alternative asset classes, and across US, European, and APAC market conventions and regulatory contexts.
  • 10+ years in real estate, proptech, or consulting, with experience leading teams of domain and technical experts.
  • Technical fluency across entity resolution, graph-based data models, and semantic layer architecture, sufficient to guide solution and demo design and engage credibly with a client's data and engineering teams on how identity, confidence, and lineage actually work under the platform, not just what the platform outputs.
  • Fluent in the shift from human-readable reporting to typed, governed interfaces built for agent consumption: why a report could tolerate semantic drift that an agent reasoning from the same data cannot, and why that difference is now a product architecture problem, not a documentation problem.
  • Demonstrated thought leadership: a track record of publishing or speaking on real assets, data, or investment strategy, not just executing someone else's narrative.
  • Executive presence to represent Cherre externally, lead the room in strategic deals, and translate technical complexity into business value for institutional buyers.
  • The ability to operate as both a player and a coach: both getting hands-on in deals, and effective at hiring, developing, and leading a high-performing team behind you.
  • An AI-forward mindset, with hands-on experience building tools, automations, or agentic workflows.

Nice to have experience with:

  • AI tools such as Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT
  • Building AI agents and agentic workflows
  • Interacting with Github
  • Experience with knowledge management tools such as Obsidian

Pay Range

USD $190,000.00 - USD $235,000.00 /Yr.

This opportunity is remote/virtual or hybrid, therefore open to all candidates nationally

Our team and what we'll accomplish together

At TELUS Agriculture & Consumer Goods, our North America Consumer Goods team partners with CPG manufacturers, brands, and distributors to drive competitive advantage at the shelf and in the field. Our sales organization is the engine driving market adoption of our enterprise SaaS platform—and you'll be the operational strategist architecting the processes, data infrastructure, and systems that enable our team to execute at scale.

You'll collaborate with sales leadership and cross-functional teams to optimize sales processes, drive revenue growth, and improve efficiency across our CPG-focused sales motion—supporting everything from funnel hygiene and territory management to CRM administration and sales enablement content. This is a strategic role where operational excellence directly enables revenue acceleration: your work on forecast accuracy, pipeline integrity, and cross-functional alignment will be foundational to our growth trajectory. If you thrive on owning ambiguous, complex problems in matrixed environments and view operational excellence as a strategic competitive advantage, this role offers the scope and impact you're seeking.

What you'll do

Sales Analytics & Pipeline Intelligence

  • Develop and maintain the reporting infrastructure that drives leadership decision-making across the North America sales organization, including MTD/QTD forecasts, product-line funnel analysis, opportunity stage tracking by account and category, and regional performance metrics
  • Conduct diagnostic sales performance analysis to identify conversion bottlenecks, forecast accuracy gaps, and sales cycle inefficiencies; translate findings into actionable recommendations for leadership
  • Build and own rolling forecasts and quota models tied to TELUS CG's product portfolio (Retail Execution, TPM, RGM, Sales Enablement, Shopper Insights) and regional targets
  • Partner with Marketing and Customer Success on reporting that bridges sales pipeline health with downstream operational performance and customer outcomes
  • Provide ad hoc analytical support to cross-functional stakeholders on topics including product roadmap resourcing, engineering pipeline forecasts, and territory capacity planning

CRM Governance & Sales Process Excellence

  • Partner with sales leadership to design and refine the enterprise CPG sales process, accounting for the complexity of longer, multi-stakeholder buying cycles involving manufacturers, brands, retailers, and category management teams; establish best practices in lead management, opportunity tracking, and pipeline optimization specific to CPG/retail buying dynamics
  • Own funnel hygiene practices and controls: ensure closed-won opportunities are reassigned to correct quota-bearing personnel prior to close; audit and monitor this as an ongoing governance function
  • Manage territory assignments and rebalancing across the North America sales team, incorporating new customer and prospect lists from Finance while maintaining equitable territory design
  • Oversee account and prospect ownership in cases of cross-segment overlap; execute account reassignment workflows during rep transitions with impact analysis and seamless handoffs
  • Represent Sales in Salesforce administration and CRM governance: manage renewal/auto-renewal workflows, opportunity team permissions, BDR access controls, and account ownership rules
  • Ensure consistent, accurate CRM data entry and adoption across the sales team; audit and close churn records to maintain data integrity
  • Maintain and audit account trading name/ownership rules to correctly route out-of-scope or misclassified accounts to appropriate placeholders or owners
  • Partner with the CRM platform team on system enhancements, troubleshooting, and support ticket resolution
  • Identify and implement process improvements to increase conversion rates and reduce sales cycle times across the North America region

Sales Enablement & Cross-Functional Alignment

  • Own and improve the structure and accessibility of the sales content ecosystem (Google Drive, HighSpot, or similar platforms) to ensure materials are current, organized, and discoverable
  • Coordinate creation of sales collateral tailored to CPG buyer personas: pitch decks, ROI case studies, competitive battle cards, proposal templates, and messaging frameworks
  • Collaborate with Marketing to align value proposition messaging across channels, ensuring consistency in how TELUS CG's solutions are positioned to the North America CPG market
  • Manage CRM integrations with TELUS CG platforms and adjacent sales tools (marketing automation, customer success, product usage data) to streamline workflows and data flow
  • Support opportunity creation workflows, including automated opportunity-owner and opportunity-team assignment logic
  • Maintain a central contract repository and support contract-related data needs for sales and cross-functional teams
  • Partner with Customer Success on account health tracking, CS coverage models, and related reporting
  • Partner with Marketing Ops to define and execute BDR and business development campaign processes, including event follow-up administration and lead-routing transitions; troubleshoot lead-to-MQL scoring and conversion discrepancies
  • Relay sales team feedback and customer insights to Product and Marketing to inform go-to-market strategy and roadmap priorities

What you bring

  • 4+ years of experience in sales operations, sales strategy, sales management, or related operations roles in SaaS, CPG/retail tech, or B2B enterprise software environments (this background is essential to success in this role)
  • Expert-level Salesforce proficiency, including reporting, workflow automation, opportunity and account management, data administration, and CRM governance best practices
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex data into actionable insights for sales and executive stakeholders; proficiency with SQL, Python, or advanced spreadsheet tools
  • Demonstrated expertise in process design and ownership: you can take ambiguous, cross-functional problems and design end-to-end solutions with minimal direction
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present data-driven recommendations to sales leadership and executive audiences; strong documentation and dashboard design capabilities
  • Detail-oriented and proactive mindset: you anticipate needs, identify process improvements independently, and take ownership of problems without prompting
  • Ability to thrive in matrixed environments where you partner across Sales, Product, Marketing, and Customer Success teams

Great-to-haves

  • Experience with sales forecasting, quota setting, territory management, and compensation management in regional or multi-account enterprise sales structures
  • Familiarity with sales engagement platforms (Outreach, SalesLoft) and content management platforms (HighSpot, Seismic)
  • Understanding of SaaS business metrics (CAC, LTV, churn) and CPG/retail industry dynamics (trade spend, category management, retail execution)
  • Experience managing complex Salesforce renewal/auto-renewal workflows and sophisticated account/opportunity ownership models
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Analytics, or related field

What You’ll Do

A Credentialing Specialist makes sure healthcare providers meet the necessary qualifications to provide care. The primary responsibility is to verify and assess the credentials of providers to ensure compliance with industry standards and regulatory requirements. They conduct thorough background checks to identify any potential risks or red flags that may impact patient safety. The Credentialing Specialist reviews privileges requested by the healthcare provider, compares to their education and training, contrasted with relevant experience to recommend if the individual is qualified to provide safe and competent patient care. The Credentialing Specialist ensures healthcare providers maintain their credentials by monitoring expiration dates of licenses and certifications. They may facilitate the process of updating credentials as required to ensure the caregiver and facilities remain compliant with all certification and accreditation requirements. They also serve as a point of contact for credentialing related inquiries and assists in the preparation of necessary reports. In addition to being responsible for updating and maintaining credentialing databases, scheduling and attending meetings, data entry/integrity, record management and performing other administrative tasks as assigned. This individual plays a key role in maintaining the integrity of healthcare delivery and protecting patient well-being. Following an orientation period, with appropriate knowledge in hospital medical staff credentialing; employees, at the discretion of their supervisor, may have an opportunity for a schedule to include a remote/work from home. Patient Record Abstractor fulfills a role as a Medical Coder for UCSF’s physician practices. They review patient records, discharge summaries, operative reports, and other clinical documentation to assign standardized codes for diagnoses, procedures, and services. They apply national and international coding classifications to ensure records reflect the care delivered, supporting accurate reimbursement and reliable clinical data. They have knowledge of Current Procedural Terminology (CPT), International Classification of Diseases, 10th Edition, Clinical Modification (ICD-10-CM), and Healthcare Common Procedural Coding System (HCPCS).

The role operates within a healthcare records or billing team and requires close liaison with clinicians, clinical coders, and administrative staff to resolve documentation queries. Coders must maintain currency with coding updates, compliance requirements, and professional standards, and participate in regular audits to monitor coding quality. Expectations include timely processing of case volumes while maintaining high accuracy, adherence to confidentiality and information governance standards, and contribution to process improvements that enhance data quality and coding efficiency.

The Faculty Practice Revenue Management Operations (FPRMO) department is responsible for physician-based coding for UCSF faculty. The team ensures accurate code assignment for professional services delivered across UCSF locations, affiliated community hospitals, off-license practices, and ambulatory clinics.

FPRMO supports a diverse group of providers, including physicians, nurse practitioners, and advanced practice providers, across a wide spectrum of specialties within an academic medical center environment. These specialties include Neurosurgery, Cardiovascular Services, OB/GYN, Gender Reassignment, Rheumatology, and Plastic Surgery.

FPRMO plays a critical role in the revenue cycle by delivering precise and compliant coding for approximately 1.6 million patient encounters annually, supporting both regulatory requirements and optimal reimbursement.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Work in moderate work queues daily as defined by UCSF leadership.
  • Work in simple work queues as needed.
  • Work RFI and edit work queues as needed.
  • Maintain or exceed a 95% accuracy rate.
  • Maintain productivity standards as defined by UCSF leadership.
  • Work proactively with divisions in areas of specialization to assure appropriate revenue cycle practices and compliance with internal and external regulations.
  • Code intermediate procedures/accounts requiring advanced knowledge in charge capture, workflow, hospital operations, authorizations, and the revenue cycle.
  • Resolve Claims Manager and Epic edits to ensure correct coding of services provided, including review of documentation for correct coding, evaluation and management (E/M) leveling, diagnosis coding, bundling issues, and modifier usage.
  • Apply dashboards and processes for continuous analysis of moderate revenue cycle functions of diverse scope.
  • Audit data input to support revenue cycle management.
  • Complete coding work reports, reconcile charge lists, create charge sessions, update DEPs, follow up on credential requests, and perform related coding activities.
  • Verify and correct statistical data abstracted and compiled by lower-level staff, reconcile output statistics, and perform medical coding.
  • Review APeX PB Charge Edit and RFI work queues daily or as assigned, address payor inquiries requiring department review, and resolve claim edits to ensure timely billing.
  • Proactively review assigned work queues and collaborate with faculty and ancillary providers regarding required documentation changes and updates.
  • Run reports related to assigned charges, including missing charge reports, error reports, and other reports supporting charge capture, error resolution, and throughput.
  • Under supervision, analyze charge integrity, reconciliation, and charge linkages from ancillary charging systems for the medical center/health system.

Description

Empower AI is seeking a motivated Knowledge Center Tier I Agent (Junior) to analyze and resolve support requests from the external industry partners and users of a Department of War agency on its portfolio of mission applications (e.g., DISS, NISS, NBIS). External users reach the Knowledge Center by toll-free phone, support email, public web form, and public chatbot; the agent determines what the user needs and how urgent it is, creates and manages the ticket on the user's behalf, resolves common account, access, and navigation issues using documented procedures, and decides when to escalate. Every ticket follows the email-based Customer-Confirmed Ticket Closure process. This is a primarily remote position and an excellent entry point into Federal IT customer support. This is a salaried, FLSA-exempt position in which you will independently analyze situations, determine the appropriate course of action, and exercise discretion and independent judgment on matters of significance to the program and its customers.

THIS IS A REMOTE ROLE WITH UP TO 10% OF TRAVEL INVOLVED.

JOB DUTIES:

  • Determine the resolution approach for common Tier I external-user issues on DISS, NISS, NBIS, and other designated applications using knowledge articles and documented procedures, and decide when escalation to the KC Escalation Coordinator is required.
  • Manage external-user communication through the email-based Customer-Confirmed Ticket Closure process and safeguard sensitive user information in accordance with Privacy Act and CUI requirements.

  • Resolve account, access, connectivity, and application issues by selecting and applying the correct diagnostic and remediation steps, including administrative actions on user accounts and configurations within delegated authority.
  • Evaluate whether resolution actions have fully addressed the customer's need before placing tickets in "Resolved - Awaiting Customer Confirmation" status under the Customer-Confirmed Ticket Closure process, and document resolutions clearly for reuse by other analysts.
  • Assess the age and risk of items in the open ticket queue, decide which require follow-up with users or resolver groups, and take action to prevent tickets from breaching resolution SLAs.

Qualifications

  • Must be within investigation scope and/or currently enrolled in Continuous Evaluation / Continuous Vetting.

  • Demonstrated ability to work independently, analyze problems, determine the appropriate course of action, and exercise discretion and independent judgment with limited day-to-day supervision.

  • Strong customer service orientation, patience, and the ability to communicate clearly with non-technical users by phone and in writing.
  • Ability to follow documented procedures precisely while handling a high volume of contacts in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience or demonstrated aptitude supporting external customers or the public through phone, email, and web channels; ability to work assigned shifts within 6:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m. ET; this position primarily works remotely.

DESIRED SKILLS:

  • HDI Customer Service Representative, HDI Support Center Analyst, or ITIL 4 Foundation certification.

Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.


About the Role:

CrowdStrike Falcon Host is a two-component security product. One component is a “sensor”: a driver installed on client machines that observes system activity and recognizes malicious behavior, then provides on-box prevention capability and remote telemetry to the Falcon Host cloud. The sensor processes thousands of events per second to provide deep visibility into operations on the endpoint, and performs rich correlation and computation to identify malicious events and blocks malicious activity.

The cloud component aggregates sensor telemetry for each customer’s network, correlates malicious behavior across multiple machines, and presents our customers’ operations teams with a prioritized summary of the threats detected in their environments.


This is a Senior Software Development Engineer (SDE) role in the CTIO team that delivers the cutting edge innovation for our sensor (lightweight agent) for Linux, Windows, and Mac OS platforms. The SDE’s in the team own design and development of core features on the platform. Features will cross-cut most core OS subsystems such as file system, memory, process, and networking. Many features are also built in a way that they will have shared components across Linux, Windows, and MacOS. The team operates under the Agile development principles and ships frequently.


The CTIO team at CrowdStrike is responsible for defining and executing the company's technology vision and strategy, driving innovation and overseeing the development and evolution of the Falcon platform. The CTIO ensures CrowdStrike maintains its position as a technology leader by fostering engineering excellence, aligning technical capabilities with business objectives, and anticipating emerging threats and market trends.

  • Collaborate with all the sensor development teams, across the company, on architecture and strategic initiatives.
  • Conceptualize and develop new product features.

  • Take ownership of features throughout the entire lifecycle, from initial design to final delivery, including presenting product demonstrations at the conclusion of each sprint.
  • Engage in cross-functional collaboration with teams situated in various locations.

  • Proven experience in debugging memory corruption issues, process contentions, and system performance bottlenecks.

  • Ability to lead, mentor, communicate, collaborate, and operate effectively within a geographically distributed team.
  • Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.

Intertek, a Nationally Recognized Testing Lab (NRTL) and leading provider of ATIC (Assurance, Testing, Inspection, and Certification) Services to many of the world’s leading brands and companies, is actively seeking a Remote Part-Time Regular Electrical Product Inspector to join our Electrical team in the Eastern Pennsylvania/Northern Virginia area near Harrisburg, Pennsylvania. This is a fantastic opportunity to grow a versatile career in facilitating international trade and regulatory product testing on the Electrical Team!

Intertek's Electrical business line applies more than 100 years of product testing expertise to quickly and efficiently help clients meet safety, performance, environmental and quality requirements for every market. Spanning a wide range of industries such as Medical, Lighting, Renewable Energy, HVACR, Appliances & Electronics, Hazardous Locations, Industrial Equipment, Life Safety & Security, IT & Telecom Equipment, Intertek's global network of laboratories employ world-class experts in their fields who deliver quality, accurate testing and certification that continually exceeds our clients' expectations and helps to clear a path for their product's success. Intertek is continually innovating and evolving to reduce risk for consumers, brands and organizations in every sector and industry around the world.

We go beyond Testing, Inspection and Certification of products: we are a Total Quality Assurance Provider to industries worldwide. Our Purpose: Bringing quality, safety, and sustainability to life.

What are we looking for?

This Electrical Product Inspector position is responsible for performing inspections at manufacturing facilities to ensure that products are being manufactured in accordance with established standards and specifications created by Intertek. This opportunity is part-tine, and ideal for someone who is able to be flexible based on the needs of the clients and does not work another job.

This is a remote position; however, applicants must reside in and be able to legally work in the United States.

Salary & Benefits Information

The base wage or salary range for this position is $36/Hr. to $42/Hr. Individual compensation packages are based on a variety of factors unique to each candidate including skill set, experience, qualifications and other job-related reasons.

What you’ll do:

  • Plan and conduct surveillance inspections in accordance with scheduling requirements.
  • Document manufacturer’s production and quality processes; review required production tests, including methods, equipment used and calibration of equipment.
  • Inspect ETL Listed products, subassemblies and components with respect to the Certification Documents; review ETL label inventory and control; review non-compliances issued as a result of previous inspections and document unresolved issues; select samples as directed.
  • Document compliance and non-compliance found during the inspection and advise clients on proper resolution.
  • Complete and submit Follow-up Service Inspection Report for each client inspected.
  • Communicate information between facility representatives and Intertek personnel.
  • Maintain expenses within given guidelines.
  • Perform other work as required.

MinimumRequirements & Qualifications:

  • High School Diploma or GED AND 10+ years directly related experience;
  • OR Associate Degree in related area AND 5+ years directly related experience;
  • OR Bachelor’s Degree in related area AND 1+ year directly related experience
  • Experience in electronic/electrical testing or quality/reliability testing, engineering, electrical inspection, manufacturing or quality control
  • Must have a valid driver’s license and reliable driving record
  • Must have access to the internet
  • Ability to lift up to 40 pounds
  • Ability to stand for prolonged periods of time
  • Ability to climb stairs and ladders
  • Ability to travel as business needs dictate, up to 75%
  • Applicants must reside in and be able to legally work in the United States.
  • Applicants will be required to complete an I-9 to verify their eligibility to work in the U.S.

Preferred Requirements & Qualifications:

  • Familiarity with the “National Electric Code” and/or product compliance requirements to nationally recognized safety standards
  • Knowledge of Quality Control methods (ISO 9000/14000, QS 9000, Six Sigma, Lean Manufacturing, Kaizen & Statistical Process Control)

Intertek Total Quality Assured

Intertek is a world leader in the Quality Assurance market, with a proven, high-quality business model and a global network of customer-focused operations and highly engaged subject matter experts. A note from the founder

TWF has built the scaffolding for federal work. MBE certification, SAM.gov registration, two operational divisions ready to serve federal contracts, a credentialed bench, and signed commercial customers proving the operating model. What is missing is the capture function. This engagement is for the operator who knows how to walk a federal opportunity from first signal through awarded contract, and who wants to build that function inside a firm where it does not exist yet.

What is already built

The Wilkinson Firm is a workforce strategy and staffing firm headquartered across NC and Atlanta. We launched in April 2025 and are now in Year 2 of operations. Two operational divisions today (HR Advisory for the mental health industry, Premium Hospitality and Event Staffing). Government Contracting division being formally stood up this quarter. Three active staffing contracts in delivery. FY26 trajectory $425-525K. Zero loans, zero institutional debt. Defined path to $5M+ over the next 24 months.

Federal-relevant scaffolding:[- Two operational divisions ready to serve federal contracts in HHS-adjacent verticals (VA mental health programs, DoD behavioral health support, HHS workforce IDIQs) and hospitality (federal lodging, on-base food service, training facility F&B).

  • Capture-to-proposal lifecycle: opportunity assessment, teaming strategy, technical and price strategy, color-team reviews, submission readiness

Engagement structure

Hourly consulting rate, three tiers calibrated to experience and scope:

  • Foundational ($100-200/hr): Capture managers with 5-8 years experience, ramping into a director role
  • Director ($200-350/hr): Established capture directors with documented win history on $1M+ contracts
  • Principal ($350-500/hr): Senior capture principals with multi-million-dollar award history and Tier 1 prime experience

Engagement is hourly. Time commitment scales with pipeline activity, typically 10-40 hours per week. Win-based bonus stack negotiable on top of hourly rate for awarded contracts the engagement materially drove.

Success milestones

  • Day 90: 2-4 active captures in formal pursuit. First teaming agreements signed. Pipeline value $1M+.
  • Day 180: 2-4 proposals submitted. First award or shortlist position. Win rate baseline established.

Who you are

  • Shipley-trained or equivalent. SAM.gov fluent. Comfortable with FAR/DFARS terminology

  3. Reference checks (3+ professional references) and work history verification

2-4 weeks first conversation to active engagement.

What we believe

Trust before revenue. Mission before money. Real seats, real upside. We build durable federal relationships through earned credibility. We win together. We pay people in real numbers, not pizza parties. We are building something great and we want partners who feel the same.
