jobs.excerpt: About Argano Argano is a global specialist consultancy and the High-Performance Operations partner to mid-market and large enterprises.
jobs.description:
About Argano

Argano is a global specialist consultancy and the High-Performance Operations partner to mid-market and large enterprises. We combine deep, practitioner-level industry expertise with connected capability across the platforms that run modern operations — Oracle, SAP, Microsoft, Salesforce, Workday, UKG, Anaplan, Blue Yonder, Databricks and more — to help clients turn technology, data, and AI into measurable operational results. Clients choose Argano for boutique-quality delivery at enterprise scale: the business-problem-first thinking of a specialist with the breadth and reliability to execute across a heterogeneous technology estate.

The Opportunity

Industry analysts shape how buyers, publishers, and private-equity sponsors perceive the services market. As Argano moves from a collection of acquired practices into one unified operating model, we need a single, credible owner of our relationships with Gartner, Forrester, IDC, Everest Group, HFS, ISG, and the other firms that rank and evaluate our space.

The Director, Analyst Relations will build and run Argano’s analyst relations program from the ground up: the engagement strategy, the operating cadence, the executive preparation, the evaluation and RFI submissions, and the loop that brings analyst research and market insight back into our business units and go-to-market. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can set the strategy and also personally drive the briefing calendar, the submission tracker, and the executive prep deck.

You will report to the SVP of Marketing and work daily with Argano’s CEO, Chief Growth Officer, Presidents, business-unit and practice leaders, and the corporate marketing, communications, and demand-generation teams.

What You Will Do

Analyst engagement strategy

  • Build, own, and continuously refine a multi-year analyst relations strategy that supports Argano’s corporate and business-unit growth priorities — including which firms, analysts, and evaluations matter most, and why.

  • Map the analyst landscape across our publisher practices (Oracle, SAP, Microsoft, Salesforce, Workday, UKG, Anaplan, Blue Yonder, Databricks), our offerings (AI, Connect, Managed Services, HCM, Supply Chain, Revenue Operations), and our priority verticals (healthcare and life sciences, pharma, manufacturing, homebuilding, wholesale and distribution).

  • Recommend and manage analyst firm relationships and subscriptions, including scope, budget, renewals, and inquiry usage, so the company gets measurable value from every contract.

  • Define and report the KPIs for the program — inclusion and placement in key evaluations, briefing volume and quality, analyst sentiment, referenced mentions in research, inquiry usage, and analyst-influenced pipeline.

Evaluations, RFIs, and report submissions

  • Own the calendar of Magic Quadrants, Waves, MarketScapes, PEAK Matrix assessments, Horizons reports, Provider Lens studies, and other evaluations relevant to Argano; decide where we participate and manage the end-to-end response.

  • Project-manage each RFI and submission: assemble the cross-functional team, build the work plan, gather and validate data, coordinate customer references, write and edit the narrative, and deliver on time and to a high standard.

  • Prepare and coach executives and practice leaders for evaluation demos and briefings, and manage post-evaluation fact-checks, reviews, and debriefs.

  • Maintain a reusable library of company facts, proof points, case studies, metrics, and boilerplate so every submission is consistent, current, and on-message.

Briefings, inquiries, and executive preparation

  • Run a proactive briefing and inquiry program: secure the right analyst meetings, set objectives, build the narrative and materials, and follow up on commitments.

  • Prepare Argano executives ahead of every analyst interaction with concise briefing documents covering the analyst’s coverage, recent research, prior interactions, likely questions, and our key messages.

  • Manage analyst participation in Argano events, customer stories, and thought-leadership programs, and coordinate analyst speaking, quotes, and content licensing with marketing and communications.

  • Track every interaction, commitment, and outcome in a shared analyst relations system of record.

Voice of the market into the business

  • Monitor, curate, and distribute relevant analyst research to business-unit, practice, sales, and marketing leaders, with clear summaries of what it means for Argano.

  • Translate analyst research and inquiry insights into implications for positioning, offering development, competitive strategy, and go-to-market planning; partner with product marketing on messaging and with sales enablement on competitive intelligence.

  • Bring the outside-in perspective into planning cycles — quarterly business reviews, offering roadmaps, and annual marketing and growth planning.

  • Enable sales and delivery teams to use analyst recognition and research appropriately in pursuits, proposals, and client conversations.

Program operations

  • Establish the operating rhythm for the program: the annual plan, the quarterly review with executive leadership, briefing and submission calendars, and a reporting dashboard.

  • Manage analyst relations budget, agency or contractor support, and analyst firm contracts.

  • Ensure compliance with each analyst firm’s citation, quotation, and reprint policies, and with Argano’s brand and communications standards.

What You Bring

Required

  • 5–7+ years of experience in analyst relations, or a closely related mix of analyst relations, public relations, product marketing, or corporate communications, with demonstrated ownership of analyst programs and evaluations.

  • Direct working experience with Gartner, Forrester, IDC, Everest Group, HFS, ISG, or comparable firms, including managing Magic Quadrant, Wave, PEAK Matrix, or similar evaluation submissions from start to finish.

  • Strong understanding of the technology and professional services market, ideally within consulting, systems integration, managed services, or enterprise software.

  • Excellent executive-facing communication skills; able to distill complex research into crisp briefs and coach senior leaders with confidence and tact.

  • Outstanding writing and editing skills, with the judgment to keep submissions accurate, differentiated, and on-message.

  • Proven project management ability across multiple concurrent, deadline-driven, cross-functional workstreams.

  • Comfortable working hands-on in a growing organization where you build the process rather than inherit it.

  • Bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, business, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Preferred

  • Experience at a consulting or services firm with multi-publisher practices (Oracle, SAP, Microsoft, Salesforce, Workday) and a background in how those ecosystems and their analyst coverage intersect.

  • Familiarity with services-industry evaluations such as the Everest Group PEAK Matrix, HFS Horizons, ISG Provider Lens, and IDC MarketScape.

  • Experience integrating analyst insight into product marketing, competitive intelligence, or account-based marketing programs.

  • Experience supporting a private-equity-backed or acquisitive company through brand and operating-model integration.

  • Working knowledge of AI, data, and connectivity trends shaping enterprise operations.

How Success Looks in Year One

  • First 90 days: Complete the analyst landscape map, audit current firm relationships and subscriptions, meet every executive and practice leader, and stand up the briefing calendar, submission tracker, and executive briefing template.

  • First 6 months: Publish the analyst engagement strategy and annual plan; deliver our first prioritized evaluation submissions on time and with executive-ready prep; launch a regular research digest for business-unit and GTM leaders.

jobs.excerpt: Who We AreWe’re Personified: a managed IT + cybersecurity services provider for campaigns, non-profits, and mission-aligned organizations.
jobs.description:
Who We Are

We’re Personified: a managed IT + cybersecurity services provider for campaigns, non-profits, and mission-aligned organizations. Our mission is to lead technology and security programs for our clients, enabling them to focus on their mission-critical work.

We act as an extension of our client teams — we handle all the responsibilities a traditional internal IT team would. We’re in our clients’ Slacks, we’re on a first-name basis with them (and their pets), we’re new hires’ first point of contact, and we’re the first stop for tech and cybersecurity issues. We aim to build trust, and we leverage this to keep the bad actors out.

Some of the biggest names in the progressive space have leaned on us as their trusted IT + cybersecurity partner. We are looking for top IT talent as we continue to scale our team.

About the Role

Personified is looking for a Senior Vice President of Technology to run the operational core of our technology organization: engineering, client support, cybersecurity, and IT operations. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who has run these functions inside a managed service provider before and knows exactly what breaks at scale: ticket queues, on-call rotations, security posture, tooling debt, and how to fix it without slowing the team down.

You'll report to the CTO and own execution across four functional leaders and the day-to-day delivery. You are the person who makes sure the trains run on time, the team is accountable, and our 97% client retention rate stays exactly where it is, or gets better.

This role exists because Personified is growing past the point where one person can run every function directly. We need someone who has done this before, who can walk into a room of client support engineers or a security incident and immediately know what questions to ask.

Key Responsibilities

  • Client Support & Service Delivery — Ensure the team hits our response-time and resolution standards across every client tier. Own escalation paths, staffing models, and the systems (like our Halo ticketing platform) that keep support predictable and measurable.
  • Engineering — Oversee infrastructure, systems engineering, and technical delivery. Set standards for process discipline, documentation, and accountability across the engineering team.
  • Cybersecurity — Own the operational security posture across our client base: monitoring, incident response, vulnerability management, and compliance readiness. Make sure security isn't a side conversation — it's built into how we operate.
  • IT Operations — Drive the shift from manual, reactive IT operations toward automation and repeatable processes. Reduce the operational load on the team while improving consistency for clients.
  • People leadership — Directly manage functional leaders across these four areas. Set clear expectations, run a real performance management cadence, and build a bench of leaders under you who can eventually run without your direct involvement.
  • Cross-functional operations — Be the connective tissue between functions that too often operate in silos. When a client issue touches support, engineering, and security at once, you're the person who makes sure it gets resolved as one coordinated response, not three separate ones.
  • Metrics and accountability — Build and own the operational scorecard for technology delivery: response times, resolution rates, security incidents, retention impact. Bring data, not anecdotes, to every conversation with the CTO.
  • Travel or work or present onsite as needed to support business needs, ensure continuity of service, and represent Personified to our clients and partners at the highest level.

Skills + Experience

  • 8+ years in technology operations leadership, with at least 4 in a managed service provider (MSP) environment, you understand ticket economics, SLAs, multi-client environments, and the specific pressure of supporting many organizations at once rather than one.
  • Direct people-management experience across multiple technical functions simultaneously (not just one discipline). You've managed managers, not just individual contributors.
  • A track record of taking an under-disciplined operation and making it measurably more consistent, without making it slower or more bureaucratic.
  • Real fluency in cybersecurity operations; you don't need to be the deepest technical expert in the room, but you need to know enough to ask sharp questions and hold a security leader accountable.
  • Experience building or scaling IT automation — you should be able to speak concretely about a time you replaced manual process with something repeatable.
  • A communication style that is direct and specific. You document decisions. You don't let vague problems stay vague.

What Would Make You a Great Fit Here

  • You've worked with or served mission-driven, nonprofit, or advocacy organizations before, and you understand why 'the client hired us so they never have to think about IT again' is a real design principle, not a slogan.
  • You're comfortable in a smaller, fast-moving company where your title doesn't insulate you from doing real work.
  • You believe good process makes teams faster, not slower, and you can tell the difference between bureaucracy and discipline.
  • You want to build a team, not just manage one that already exists.

Reporting Structure

This role has direct management authority over the functional leaders in Client Support, Engineering, Cybersecurity, and IT Operations. It reports to the CTO, who retains direct ownership of Technical Programs and Training/Content, along with technology strategy, senior-level accountability, and cross-company initiatives.

Benefits

  • Healthcare packages contributed to by Personified

Engagement type: Independent consultant, 1099 hourly.
Rate range: $100 - $500 per hour, based on experience and scope (three-tier band detailed below).

Location: Fully remote.
Reports to: GovCon Division Lead, with dotted line to the Federal Capture Director.

A note from the founder

A great proposal is the difference between a captured opportunity and an awarded contract. We have the capture motion ramping up. We need the operator who turns the captured opportunity into a compliant, compelling, on-time response, and who builds the response library so every future proposal moves faster than the last.

What is already built

The Wilkinson Firm is a workforce strategy and staffing firm headquartered across NC and Atlanta. We launched in April 2025 and are now in Year 2 of operations. Two operational divisions today (HR Advisory for the mental health industry, Premium Hospitality and Event Staffing). Government Contracting division being formally stood up this quarter. Three active staffing contracts in delivery. FY26 trajectory $425-525K. Zero loans, zero institutional debt.

Bench credentials: Former EEOC Administrative Law Judge, employment attorneys (JD, MBA), clinical advisors, 32-year enterprise operations specialist. 47 combined years HHS experience.

What you own

  • Full proposal lifecycle: kickoff, compliance matrix, schedule, color-team reviews (pink, red, gold), production, submission
  • Technical writing and editing across executive summary, technical approach, management approach, past performance, and resumes of key personnel
  • Compliance matrix ownership: every shall, every Section L and M requirement, every page count, every font and margin spec
  • Response library build: past performance citations, key personnel resumes, technical narratives, reusable management approach modules, pricing structures
  • Coordination with the Federal Capture Director on win themes, discriminators, and ghosting strategy
  • Coordination with subcontractor partners on teaming inputs and price submissions
  • Post-submission tracking, debrief capture, and lessons-learned documentation

Engagement structure

Hourly consulting rate, three tiers calibrated to experience and scope:

  • Writer ($100-175/hr): Proposal writers and coordinators with 3-7 years federal proposal experience
  • Manager ($175-325/hr): Proposal managers with documented win history and full-lifecycle ownership
  • Principal ($325-500/hr): Senior proposal directors with multi-million-dollar award history and Tier 1 prime experience

Engagement is hourly. Per-proposal scope and budget defined at proposal kickoff. Win-based bonus stack negotiable on top of hourly rate for proposals that result in awarded contracts.

Success milestones

  • First 60 days: Proposal process documented. Compliance matrix template built. Response library framework established with 5+ reusable past performance citations.
  • First 120 days: First 1-2 proposals submitted on time, compliant, and competitive. Color-team review cadence established.
  • First 180 days: 3-5 proposals submitted. First award or shortlist position. Response library covers 80% of TWF's standard content needs.

Who you are

  • 5-15 years in federal proposal management, technical writing, or capture support
  • Documented track record managing $1M+ federal proposals through full lifecycle to submission
  • Shipley-trained or equivalent. APMP credential preferred
  • Fluent in FAR/DFARS, RFP structure (Sections L and M), and compliance matrix methodology
  • Strong writing voice: clear, persuasive, and adaptable across technical and management content
  • Comfortable working both as lead writer and as orchestrator of subject matter expert input
  • Past performance citations in workforce services, HHS programs, hospitality contracting, or staffing IDIQs preferred
  • Located anywhere in the US

Bonus points

  • Prior role at a Tier 1 GovCon prime or boutique proposal shop
  • Experience with VA, HHS, DoD behavioral health, or federal hospitality contracts
  • Pricing strategy fluency (cost narrative, BOEs, indirect rate structures)
  • Experience standing up a proposal function inside an emerging GovCon firm

How we will get to know each other

  1. Initial 30-minute fit conversation with the GovCon Division Lead
  2. Working session: walk through a real proposal scenario we are actively considering or recently submitted
  3. Reference checks (3+ professional references) and work history verification
  4. Engagement letter, scope of work, and rate confirmation
  5. Kickoff within 7 days of signed engagement

What we believe

Trust before revenue. Mission before money. Real seats, real upside. We build durable federal relationships through earned credibility. We win together. We pay people in real numbers, not pizza parties.

Application tips

  1. Visit , ,
  2. Find The Wilkinson Firm on LinkedIn
  3. In your cover note, answer two questions: (1) what's the engagement shape that works best for you (project-based, retained hours, hybrid), and (2) one example of a federal proposal you would point to as your strongest reference work

What to expect from us

  • Reply within 48 hours
  • First-round conversation within 7 days of qualification
  • Full process: 2-4 weeks
  • We tell you yes or no. We do not ghost.

A great proposal is the difference between a captured opportunity and an awarded contract. We have the capture motion ramping up. We need the operator who turns the captured opportunity into a compliant, compelling, on-time response, and who builds the response library so every future proposal moves faster than the last.

What is already built

The Wilkinson Firm is a workforce strategy and staffing firm headquartered across NC and Atlanta. We launched in April 2025 and are now in Year 2 of operations. Two operational divisions today (HR Advisory for the mental health industry, Premium Hospitality and Event Staffing). Government Contracting division being formally stood up this quarter. Three active staffing contracts in delivery. FY26 trajectory $425-525K. Zero loans, zero institutional debt.

Bench credentials: Former EEOC Administrative Law Judge, employment attorneys (JD, MBA), clinical advisors, 32-year enterprise operations specialist. 47 combined years HHS experience.

What you own

Engagement structure

Hourly consulting rate, three tiers calibrated to experience and scope:

  • Writer ($100-175/hr): Proposal writers and coordinators with 3-7 years federal proposal experience
  • Manager ($175-325/hr): Proposal managers with documented win history and full-lifecycle ownership
  • Principal ($325-500/hr): Senior proposal directors with multi-million-dollar award history and Tier 1 prime experience

Engagement is hourly. Per-proposal scope and budget defined at proposal kickoff. Win-based bonus stack negotiable on top of hourly rate for proposals that result in awarded contracts.

Success milestones

  • First 60 days: Proposal process documented. Compliance matrix template built. Response library framework established with 5+ reusable past performance citations.

Who you are

  • Shipley-trained or equivalent. APMP credential preferred
  • Fluent in FAR/DFARS, RFP structure (Sections L and M), and compliance matrix methodology

Bonus points

  • Pricing strategy fluency (cost narrative, BOEs, indirect rate structures)
  • Experience standing up a proposal function inside an emerging GovCon firm

How we will get to know each other

  1. Initial 30-minute fit conversation with the GovCon Division Lead
  2. Working session: walk through a real proposal scenario we are actively considering or recently submitted
  3. Reference checks (3+ professional references) and work history verification

  5. Kickoff within 7 days of signed engagement

What we believe

Trust before revenue. Mission before money. Real seats, real upside. We build durable federal relationships through earned credibility. We win together. We pay people in real numbers, not pizza parties.

Application tips

jobs.excerpt: Position:Chief Financial Officer (CFO) About the RoleWe are seeking an accomplished and commercially strategic Chief Financial Officer (CFO) to lead the financial strategy, financial performance, capital management, investment finance, treasury, reporting, and financial governance of a diversified Insurance & Investment organization.
jobs.description:
Position:Chief Financial Officer (CFO)

About the Role

We are seeking an accomplished and commercially strategic Chief Financial Officer (CFO) to lead the financial strategy, financial performance, capital management, investment finance, treasury, reporting, and financial governance of a diversified Insurance & Investment organization.

The CFO will serve as a key member of the executive leadership team and strategic advisor to the CEO/President and Board, providing leadership across financial planning, insurance accounting, capital and solvency management, investment portfolio performance, asset-liability management, treasury, risk, regulatory reporting, and corporate development.

The successful candidate will combine deep financial expertise with strong commercial and investment acumen and will be capable of operating in a highly regulated financial-services environment.

Key Responsibilities

1. Financial Strategy & Executive Leadership

Develop and execute the organization's overall financial strategy.

Advise the CEO, President, and Board on financial performance, capital allocation, investment strategy, and enterprise value creation.

Translate corporate strategy into financial plans, budgets, forecasts, and measurable objectives.

Lead financial decision-making across insurance, investment, and corporate operations.

Establish strong financial governance and accountability across the organization.

2. Financial Planning, Budgeting & Performance

Lead annual budgeting, forecasting, and long-term financial planning.

Develop financial models and scenario analyses to support strategic decisions.

Monitor revenue, profitability, expenses, capital efficiency, and operating performance.

Establish financial KPIs and executive dashboards.

Identify opportunities to improve profitability, efficiency, and shareholder returns.

3. Insurance Finance & Performance

Oversee financial management of insurance operations, including premiums, claims, reserves, expenses, and underwriting performance.

Monitor key insurance financial metrics including loss ratios, combined ratios, expense ratios, and underwriting profitability.

Partner with actuarial, underwriting, claims, and risk teams to assess financial performance and emerging exposures.

Ensure appropriate financial treatment and reporting of insurance liabilities and reserves.

Support pricing, product profitability, reinsurance, and portfolio decisions from a financial perspective.

4. Investment Finance & Portfolio Management

Provide financial oversight of the organization's investment portfolio and investment activities.

Partner with the CIO/Chief Investment Officer and Investment Committee on portfolio strategy and performance.

Monitor investment income, realized/unrealized gains, asset allocation, liquidity, and risk-adjusted returns.

Evaluate investment opportunities and strategic asset-allocation decisions.

Ensure investment activities are aligned with the organization's liabilities, liquidity requirements, risk appetite, and regulatory requirements.

5. Capital, Solvency & Balance Sheet Management

Lead capital planning and balance-sheet optimization.

Monitor solvency, capital adequacy, liquidity, leverage, and financial resilience.

Develop strategies to optimize the organization's capital structure and return on capital.

Assess the financial impact of major business, investment, and insurance decisions on capital requirements.

Work closely with Risk and Actuarial functions on capital and solvency assessments.

6. Asset-Liability Management (ALM)

Provide executive financial oversight of asset-liability management.

Ensure investment portfolios are appropriately aligned with insurance liabilities and liquidity requirements.

Monitor duration, interest-rate sensitivity, liquidity gaps, and market exposures.

Support development of ALM strategies and balance-sheet optimization initiatives.

Ensure appropriate financial stress testing and scenario analysis.

7. Treasury & Liquidity

Oversee treasury, cash management, liquidity planning, and banking relationships.

Maintain adequate liquidity to meet claims, operating obligations, investment commitments, and strategic requirements.

Optimize cash deployment and short-term investment strategies.

Monitor interest-rate, foreign-exchange, credit, and liquidity exposures.

Establish robust treasury policies and controls.

8. Regulatory & Financial Reporting

Ensure accurate, timely, and transparent financial reporting to the Board, shareholders, regulators, and other stakeholders.

Oversee statutory accounts, management reporting, regulatory returns, and consolidated financial statements.

Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards and insurance regulations.

Lead relationships with external auditors, regulators, actuarial advisers, tax advisers, and other professional stakeholders.

Maintain strong financial controls and governance frameworks.

9. Risk Management & Financial Controls

Establish effective financial risk-management frameworks.

Monitor exposure to market, credit, liquidity, underwriting, operational, interest-rate, and foreign-exchange risks.

Strengthen internal controls, financial policies, and governance processes.

Work closely with the CRO, Chief Actuary, CIO, and other executives to manage enterprise-wide financial risks.

Ensure appropriate stress testing and contingency planning.

10. Reinsurance & Capital Optimization

Provide financial oversight of reinsurance strategy and economics.

Evaluate the financial and capital implications of reinsurance arrangements.

Monitor reinsurance recoverables, counterparty exposure, and profitability.

Support optimization of risk transfer, capital efficiency, and balance-sheet resilience.

11. Corporate Development & Strategic Investments

Lead financial evaluation of acquisitions, strategic investments, joint ventures, and business expansion opportunities.

Oversee financial due diligence, valuation, transaction modeling, and investment cases.

Assess potential M&A opportunities and their impact on capital, solvency, earnings, and shareholder value.

Support negotiations with investors, financial institutions, and strategic partners.

12. Investor & Stakeholder Relations

Develop strong relationships with shareholders, institutional investors, banks, rating agencies, regulators, and other financial stakeholders.

Communicate financial performance, capital strategy, investment results, and business outlook to key stakeholders.

Support investor presentations, Board materials, and strategic financial communications.

13. Finance Transformation & Technology

Modernize finance systems, reporting infrastructure, ERP platforms, and financial analytics.

Improve automation, data quality, forecasting, and management reporting.

Establish real-time visibility into financial, insurance, investment, and risk performance.

Drive continuous improvement within the finance function.

14. Leadership & Talent Development

Lead Finance, FP&A, Treasury, Accounting, Financial Reporting, Tax, and related functions.

Build a high-performing and commercially focused finance organization.

Develop finance leadership talent and succession plans.

Promote a culture of integrity, accountability, financial discipline, and business partnership.

Key Performance Indicators

The CFO will be accountable for:

Revenue and earnings growth

Operating and net profitability

Return on equity (ROE)

Return on capital

Capital adequacy and solvency

Investment portfolio performance

Investment income and risk-adjusted returns

Combined ratio / underwriting profitability

Expense efficiency

Liquidity and cash-flow management

Balance-sheet optimization

Budget and forecast accuracy

Regulatory and financial reporting quality

Cost of capital

Financial risk management

Shareholder value creation

Candidate Profile

Essential Experience

15+ years of progressive finance experience, including significant executive leadership.

Previous experience as CFO, Group CFO, Finance Director, VP Finance, Deputy CFO, or equivalent.

Significant experience within insurance, asset management, investment management, banking, pensions, financial services, or a related regulated financial institution.

Strong understanding of insurance financial statements, investment portfolios, capital management, and regulatory requirements.

Proven experience managing complex balance sheets, liquidity, capital, and financial performance.

Strong experience working with Boards, regulators, auditors, investors, rating agencies, and senior executives.

Demonstrated experience in financial strategy, investment analysis, and capital allocation.

Preferred Experience

Experience as Group CFO within a diversified insurance or financial-services group.

Experience across both insurance and investment/asset-management businesses.

Experience with life insurance, general insurance, health insurance, pensions, or reinsurance.

Exposure to institutional investment portfolios and alternative investments.

Experience with M&A, strategic investments, capital raising, restructuring, or corporate transformation.

Experience operating across multiple jurisdictions or regulated markets.

Experience interacting with insurance regulators and rating agencies.

Education & Professional Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related discipline.

Professional qualification such as CA, ACCA, CPA, CMA, CFA, or equivalent strongly preferred.

MBA or Master's degree in Finance/Business is an advantage.

Relevant insurance, actuarial, investment, or risk-management qualifications are advantageous.

Core Competencies

Insurance Finance

Corporate Finance

Investment Finance

Capital & Solvency Management

Asset-Liability Management

Treasury & Liquidity

Financial Planning & Analysis

Investment Analysis

Financial Modeling

Risk Management

Regulatory Reporting

Insurance Accounting

M&A & Corporate Development

Capital Allocation

Investor Relations

Corporate Governance

Financial Transformation

Leadership Characteristics

The successful CFO will be:

Strategic, commercially minded, and financially rigorous

Highly analytical and investment-oriented

Experienced in highly regulated environments

Strong in capital and balance-sheet management

Comfortable engaging with Boards, regulators, investors, and rating agencies

Able to balance growth, profitability, liquidity, capital, and risk

An effective strategic partner to the CEO, CIO, CRO, and Chief Actuary

A transformational finance leader capable of building high-performing teams

jobs.description:
Overview

The Senior Manager, Audit Manager Training leads the design, delivery, and continuous improvement of training and capability-building programs for audit managers and quality audit staff across CCV. This leader owns the curriculum that prepares auditors and audit managers to apply audit guidelines accurately and consistently, including training on AI-supported review tools, human-in-the-loop workflows, and the judgment required to validate AI-assisted findings. The role partners closely with Quality Audit Operations, concept development, machine learning and strategic analytics, and client service teams to translate evolving audit guidelines, quality findings, and emerging AI capabilities into effective, measurable training that improves accuracy, consistency, and readiness across the audit workforce. Grounded in Cotiviti's values—Deeply Curious, People Obsessed, Make it Count, and Build it Better—the Senior Manager fosters a culture of learning, accountability, and continuous improvement. This role is expected to move beyond delivering training sessions to proactively identify skill and knowledge gaps, close them through targeted learning interventions, and confirm sustained improvement in audit performance. The Senior Manager serves as a business partner to audit operations leadership while fostering alignment among key stakeholders across CCV operations, quality assurance, content development, and technology teams.

Responsibilities

Audit Training Program Ownership

  • Owns and matures the audit training curriculum, including onboarding, ongoing certification, and advanced training paths for auditors.
  • Designs, delivers, and evaluates training on audit guidelines, sampling methodology, and quality standards, ensuring content stays current as guidelines evolve.
  • Develops and maintains training on AI-supported audit workflows, including how to validate AI-generated findings, recognize accuracy drift or exceptions, and apply human-in-the-loop review controls.
  • Partners consultatively with quality audit operations, analytics, technology, and content teams to translate quality findings and root cause analysis into targeted training interventions.
  • Builds and executes training remediation plans for identified skill or knowledge gaps, including scope, timelines, measurable success criteria, and follow-up assessment.
  • Ensures new or updated audit guidelines and AI-supported workflow changes are supported by structured rollout training, job aids, and post-implementation reinforcement.
  • Champions innovation in learning delivery, including the responsible use of generative AI tools to personalize training, accelerate onboarding, and improve knowledge retention.
  • Establishes training effectiveness metrics (e.g., assessment scores, time-to-proficiency, post-training accuracy) and reports outcomes to audit operations leadership.
  • Communicates training performance, emerging skill gaps, and remediation progress clearly to senior leadership with appropriate urgency and action orientation.

Relationship Management

  • Maintains professional relationships across audit operations, quality assurance, and the broader audit enterprise. Identifies opportunities to expand training initiatives to create measurable value for internal teams and clients.
  • Communicates training opportunities and outcomes to Cotiviti leadership.
  • Establishes reporting and insights on training program performance using metrics that matter.

Productivity Management

  • Ensures that training delivery goals and certification timelines are consistently met or exceeded. Removes roadblocks to effective learning.
  • Monitors trainer and facilitator coverage, redistributing work as necessary to achieve set targets.
  • Promptly addresses and resolves issues impacting training delivery and completion rates.
  • Builds trust, respect, and engagement through communication and positive reinforcement to create a tradition of maintaining and exceeding internal expectations.
  • Strives to continuously Build Better.

Leadership

  • Provides People Obsessed leadership by communicating expectations and future goals. Motivates trainers and instructional staff using a combination of individual, team, and department recognition.
  • Responsible for the operationalization of new training programs and initiatives, executed in collaboration with internal stakeholders including but not limited to the CCV Operations and Quality Audit teams, content teams, and the Client Service team.
  • Works closely with the quality audit team to ensure training reinforces and aligns with current audit guidelines and quality standards.
  • Works closely with teams responsible for developing clinical, coding, and quality-related content to keep training materials accurate and current.
  • Facilitates execution of new training concept development and maintenance of existing training curricula within learning management tools, and provides program oversight.

Project Management

  • Manages expectations of internal stakeholders via clear communication with audit operations leadership and business unit leadership.
  • Grasps internal operational cycles and processes as well as their impact upon training delivery.
  • Understands project scope, schedule, and resources for training initiatives.
  • Anticipates disconnects and identifies solutions.
  • Maintains a Deeply Curious mindset to follow training initiatives through to results and document improvement.

Additional Responsibilities

  • Hire, develop, coach, lead, and retain top-tier training talent, with a focus on building and improving a team and culture that supports high levels of internal and external customer satisfaction.
  • Complete all responsibilities as outlined in the annual performance review and/or goal setting.
  • Complete all special projects and other duties as assigned.
  • Must be able to perform duties with or without reasonable accommodation.

This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed and is not to be construed as an exhaustive list of responsibilities, duties and skills required. This job description does not constitute an employment agreement and is subject to change as the needs of Cotiviti and requirements of the job change.

Qualifications

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in related field required; Bachelor's degree with a training, instructional design, quality, or healthcare focus preferred — may also include education, organizational development, or a clinical/coding discipline.
  • 3+ years of technical leadership experience: people and projects, with prior experience in a training, learning and development, or quality audit role.
  • Preferred: Active Registered Nursing license.
  • Preferred: Active Coding Credential.
  • AI-native experience using generative AI applications such as Claude, Microsoft Copilot, or similar tools to design training content, improve workflow efficiency, communication, and decision support.
  • AI accuracy mindset: understanding of validation, exception review, quality drift, and human-in-the-loop controls, with the ability to translate these into effective training content and measurable accuracy improvement.
  • Instructional design skill: able to translate audit guidelines, quality findings, and workflow changes into clear, engaging, and measurable training curricula.
  • Consultative influence: uses data and business context to influence teams and drive adoption of training and process changes without creating defensiveness.
  • Proven experience influencing behavior, reinforcing expectations, and driving adoption of process, quality, or performance improvements across audit teams.
  • Remediation execution: builds practical training remediation plans with clear owners, milestones, measurable success criteria, and follow-through.
  • Executive communication: able to communicate training outcomes, skill gaps, and program performance in a concise, balanced, and leadership-ready manner.
  • Advanced knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, Macros, VLOOKUPs, queries, advanced written formulas).
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving ability.

jobs.description:
Artemis Connection is a strategic management consultancy working across the for-profit, public and social sectors. We help clients around the world identify their most pressing strategic issues and we staff teams of strategy consultants to roll up their sleeves and deliver impact. We are passionate about helping innovative and entrepreneurial leaders reach their goals through a customized project-based approach, typically focused around:

  • Bespoke Innovation, Sales, and Marketing Strategy
  • Purpose-driven Transformation
  • Embedded Strategy and Operations roles

Our founder is Christy Johnson, an entrepreneur, educator, and former McKinsey Engagement Manager. Our advisors include HR officers, executive coaches, academics, entrepreneurs, and neuroscientists. Our team is made up of seasoned consultants, trained at organizations such as McKinsey & Company, Boston Consulting Group (BCG), Bain, Big 4 Strategy, and elite educational institutions.

What makes Artemis Connection unique is the opportunity to combine this first-rate consulting experience with the flexibility that many other consulting firms don’t offer. In short, we’re a consulting firm for experienced top-tier consultants who still want to deliver exemplary value for clients but who need more flexibility in their professional and personal lives. Specifically, we’re flexible with where you want to work and how many hours you want to work – meaning no rigid expectations of being at the client every day, living in a certain city, or clocking in a full 50 hours (or more) each week, whilst still delivering exceptional results for our clients.

Currently, our team members are spread across the country, engaging with clients remotely (occasionally on-site, as client needs dictate) and working varied hours (ranging from 10 hours/week to 55 hours/week). We offer market-rate compensation based on the outcomes that you deliver and the number of hours and weeks that you will be leading project work, plus bonuses for bringing in new clients.

Given our flexible structure and smaller size, we tend to bring on new team members in a “trial-to-hire” capacity. In other words, we initially hire individuals as independent contractorsfor discrete client projects, and then, after successful projects completion and mutual determination of “fit”, we may move towards a more permanent employment arrangement.

To learn more about Artemis Connection, visit.

Engagement Manager Position

We’re looking for experienced strategy consultants to serve as Engagement Managers on our team. (This role is roughly equivalent to an Engagement Manager at McKinsey, a Project Leader at BCG, or a Manager at Bain).

Our ideal candidate has successfully led client engagement work at a top consulting firm and is looking to continue that work in the flexible consulting model that Artemis Connection provides. She/He is a strategic thinker, structured communicator, and excellent project manager who can navigate between managing client teams and more junior Artemis Connection team members. (As such, we’re also open to candidates with in-house strategy/operations experience, if that experience has built this consulting “toolkit” of skills).

Responsibilities

The role of the Engagement Manager is to own the entire life cycleof a consulting engagement, leading the day-to-day work, managing teams of 1-6, managing upwards to engage ‘Principals’ or Senior Advisors on the team, and excellent at managing client relationships.

Pre-project preparation
Please note that pre-project activities are not compensated, as they are intended to prepare you to lead the project. It is seen as an investment you will make to start building the client trust and have more control over the scope and direction of the project.

  • Support in proposal development for a potential project you may lead if it translates into an active project
  • Participate in final business development meetings with clients to ensure that the project is scoped well and that you are able to build a strong relationship with the client from the start

Own end-to-end project delivery

  • Identify the client’s most pressing strategic issues, develop hypotheses to prove during client engagement, and communicate (then re-communicate) these issues/hypotheses to both clients and case team members as the case evolves
  • Create and maintain a project team work plan to diagnose and resolve the client’s strategic issues, including data-driven analyses, client engagements, and delivery of recommendations
  • Ensure all client deliverables are aligned with the client, and executed in a high-quality and timely way

Team Management

  • Manage teams of 1-6, providing regular coaching and input on their workstreams
  • Ensuring that team members are assigned to the highest value work, resulting in an on-budget, on-time project
  • Lead the day-to-day work of team members (e.g., structuring their analyses, reviewing their deliverables, providing on-the-job coaching)

Manage client relationships

  • Build trustworthy, transparent, and collaborative relationships with senior executives and other key contacts at client organizations
  • Facilitate client engagement in case team work, including organising client meetings and workshops, making decisions with clients at key points during case, and transitioning end-of-case recommendations or implementation plan
  • Identify opportunities for additional client work, either through follow-on work with existing clients or through potential engagements with new clients

Qualifications

  • Minimum 3 years Consulting experience,ideally from a top-tier firm (e.g., McKinsey, BCG, Bain), though in-house strategy/operations experience also considered
  • Track record of coaching clients to measurable outcomes required
  • Track record of coaching case teams (or sideways managing / informally influencing others) to measurable outcomes also required
  • Demonstrated skills in project management required, ideally in a “case team” or “client service” type of environment
  • Demonstrated skills in effective communication, including ability to build senior client relationships and effective case team relationships, required
  • Commitment to producing high-quality, client-ready work, on tight timelines, required
  • Orientation toward being a proactive, curious team member
  • Advanced proficiency in PowerPoint and Excel required, in order to coach other team members on these tools
  • Bachelor's and/or Master's Degree preferred

Other expectations

  • Ability to thrive in a remote work environment, leading team members to collaborate in a way that ensures the best client and team experience
  • Minimum time commitment of 20 hours per week
  • Willing to travel: client travel requests are typically light, as needed for client interactions

●ضمان تكامل بيانات Salesforce CRM وPartner Portal عبر رصد التناقضات وتنفيذ أطر تنظيف بيانات قابلة للتطوير.

●البحث في حالات استخدام "الذكاء الاصطناعي الوكيل (Agentic AI)" وابتكارها (‏Agentforce‏) بهدف تقليل الأعباء الإدارية على مندوبي المبيعات.

●إنشاء لوحات معلومات في Salesforce وتصوّرات باستخدام Tableau Next لتزويد القادة برؤى قابلة للتنفيذ قائمة على الحقائق.

●تسهيل جمع الملاحظات حول "Dynamic Forms" في Salesforce بهدف تبسيط تجربة المستخدم الداخلية للبائعين التابعين لنا على مستوى العالم.

●صياغة وثائق احترافية عالية الجودة والحفاظ عليها. ستتولى التأكد من أن دليل خطط دخول السوق محدّثًا، ما يسهّل فهمه وتنفيذه للأطراف المعنية على مستوى العالم.

حوّل شغفك إلى نجاح للتميّز في هذا الدور، يجب أن:

●تكون مسجلاً حاليًا في برنامج الإجازة أو الماجستير مع تاريخ تخرج في ديسمبر 2026 أو بعده.

●تتجاوز مجرد "قراءة البيانات" إلى فهم "الأسباب" الكامنة وراء الأرقام، مع التوصية بتغييرات هيكلية تتماشى مع خارطة الطريق لعام 2026.

●تظهر شغفًا عميقًا بكيفية إسهام التقنيات الناشئة (مثل Agentforce) في تحويل منظومة استراتيجية الدخول إلى السوق (GTM) على المستوى العالمي.

Job Title: Senior Client Delivery Manager – ERP Implementations and Consulting Services
Company: SHEA Syspro Team  
Location: United States or Canada (Virtual / Occasional travel to client sites)
Employment Type : Full-time

About the Role:

We are seeking an experienced Senior Client Delivery Manager to lead end-to-end ERP software implementation and consulting projects for mid-sized and enterprise clients, while also owning the account management relationship for those clients beyond go-live. You will be responsible for delivering complex ERP solutions on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards, and for managing the ongoing client account – monitoring account health, identifying opportunities for additional services and contract renewals, and nurturing long-term relationships – all while providing exceptional client experiences.

Key Responsibilities

  • Project Planning & Strategy: Develop comprehensive project plans and work breakdown structure outlining scope, budget, resource allocation, and timelines. Risks and risk mitigation
  • Stakeholder Management: Bridge the gap between executive sponsors, steering committee, client project manager, department heads, IT teams, and external software vendors.
  • Risk & Issue Mitigation: Identify potential roadblocks such as data migration issues or software limitations and establish mitigation strategies.
  • Testing & Cutover Execution: Manage system testing, data migration cycles, and the final go-live/cutover strategy.
  • Post-Implementation Support: Establish "hypercare" for a successful go-live then a transition plan to the regular support desk.
  • Work collaboratively in developing statements of work for projects.
  • Conflict management and resolution with team members.
  • Work closely with clients to gather and document business requirements, processes, and objectives.
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams including functional consultants, technical developers, data migration specialists, and quality assurance resources.
  • Facilitate workshops, status meetings, and executive steering committee updates.
  • Ensure adherence to project governance, change management, and best practices.
  • Manage client expectations and maintain strong relationships throughout the engagement.
  • Account Management: Act as the ongoing point of contact for assigned client accounts following go-live, monitoring account health and satisfaction, identifying opportunities for additional services, upsells, or contract renewals, and building long-term client relationships that support retention and account growth.
  • Oversee data migration, system integration, testing, training, and go-live support activities.
  • Identify and mitigate project risks while proactively resolving issues.
  • Provide post-implementation support and transition to support teams as needed.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of our ERP implementation methodology and templates.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field (MBA or equivalent experience preferred).
  • Minimum 5 years of professional experience in Project Management, with at least 3 years focused on ERP software implementations or similar enterprise systems.
  • Proven track record successfully delivering full-cycle ERP implementations (phases from discovery through go-live and hypercare).
  • Experience with at least one major ERP platform (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Syspro, Infor, Epicor, Sage, or similar).
  • Strong understanding of project management methodologies (PMBOK, Agile/Scrum, Waterfall, or hybrid approaches).
  • Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to travel to client sites as required (typically 10 -20%).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience implementing SYSPRO ERP (strongly preferred).
  • PMP, PRINCE2, or other relevant project management certifications.
  • Prior consulting services background (Big 4, mid-market, or boutique ERP consulting firm).
  • Experience in one or more industry verticals such as manufacturing, distribution, or wholesale.
  • Knowledge of SQL, data migration tools, integration platforms (e.g., Boomi, MuleSoft), AI platforms, and reporting tools.

What We Offer

  • Competitive base salary and performance-based bonus.
  • Comprehensive benefits package (health, dental, vision, 401(k)/RRSP, etc.).
  • Flexible remote work policy across the US and Canada.
  • Professional development opportunities certification support.
  • Collaborative and growth-oriented work environment.

We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applications from qualified candidates across the United States and Canada.

Recruitment Disclaimer

Solen Software Group will never request payment, banking information, or other sensitive personal or financial details during any stage of the recruitment process. All official communication will come from a verified @solensoftwaregroup.com email address. Any outreach outside these standards should be disregarded and reported through our official channels.

We thank all applicants for their interest in joining Solen Software Group. Only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

Salary: $110,000 – $135,000 / year

Hiring Manager- Max Sanna

Recruiter- Chloe Joyce

Consultant, Project/Program Management

What You'll Achieve

As a Consultant in Services Project/Program Management, you will lead the end-to-end planning, execution, governance, and delivery of consulting engagements across Dell's Modern Workplace portfolio — spanning Digital Employee Experience, End User Computing & Productivity, Digital Services Management, and Workplace AI. You will work with customer executives, technical consultants, and presales teams on complex, multi-workstream engagements across EMEA that drive measurable business outcomes.

You will:

  • Lead delivery of consulting engagements — managing scope, schedule, budget, quality, and risk across portfolio pillars including Nexthink DEXOps, Microsoft 365 & Copilot, ServiceNow, and Workplace AI solutions. Establish governance frameworks including escalation paths, RACI models, and communication cadences.
  • Serve as the primary delivery point of contact for customer sponsors and stakeholders — facilitating executive workshops, steering committees, and governance forums while proactively managing customer expectations on scope, timelines, risks, and trade-offs.
  • Orchestrate cross-functional consultant teams including DEX, M365, ServiceNow, and Workplace AI specialists — coordinating multi-workstream programs, managing interdependencies, and ensuring smooth transitions between project phases and into ongoing subscription or residency-based services.
  • Manage project financials and documentation — including revenue forecasting, effort tracking, margin management, SOW development, change control, and risk/issue management, all maintained to Dell Professional Services quality standards.
  • Drive practice growth — supporting pre-sales activities such as effort estimation and solution scoping, identifying cross-sell opportunities across the Modern Workplace portfolio during delivery, contributing to methodology development, and mentoring junior project managers.

Take the First Step Towards Your Dream Career

Every Dell Technologies team member brings something unique to the table. Here's what we are looking for with this role :

Essential Requirements

  • PMP or equivalent project management certification with proven customer-facing delivery management experience.
  • Demonstrated experience managing complex, multi-workstream IT Professional Services consulting engagements — including planning, execution, financial management, risk management, and stakeholder communication.
  • Strong executive communication, stakeholder management, and workshop facilitation skills with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive alignment across cross-functional teams.
  • Familiarity with one or more Modern Workplace technology domains such as Nexthink, Microsoft 365/Entra/Intune, ServiceNow, Windows 11, or Workplace AI, along with an understanding of ITSM processes and EUC environments.
  • 12+ years with a Bachelor's degree; or 8+ years with a Master's; or 5+ years with a PhD; or equivalent experience.

Desirable Requirements

  • Experience delivering DEX, Microsoft 365, Windows 11 migration, ServiceNow, or Workplace AI projects within a Modern Workplace or Digital Workplace consulting practice; experience with Adoption & Change Management or managed deployment engagements.
  • PRINCE2, Agile/Scrum (CSM, PMI-ACP), or ITIL certifications; experience managing globally distributed delivery teams and familiarity with flagship offer or productized service delivery models.

Here's Our Story; Now Tell Us Yours

Dell Technologies helps organizations and individuals build a brighter digital tomorrow. Our company is made up of more than 150,000 people, located in over 180 locations around the world. We're proud to be a diverse and inclusive team and have an endless passion for our mission to drive human progress .

What's most important to us is that you are respected, feel like you can be yourself and have the opportunity to do the best work of your life — while still having a life. We offer excellent benefits, bonus programs, flexible work arrangements, a variety of career development opportunities, employee resource groups, and much more .

We started with computers, but we didn't stop there. We are helping customers move into the future with multi-cloud, AI and machine learning through the most innovative technology and services portfolio for the data era. Join us and become a part of what's next in technology, starting today .

You can also learn more about us by reading our latest Diversity and Inclusion Report and our plan to make the world a better place by 2030 here.

Cientista de Dados Sênior

Ciência de Dados tem como objetivo desbravar novos caminhos para permitir que as empresas respondam às suas questões mais urgentes. Como pioneiros no processamento analítico intensivo de dados em larga escala e com alto nível de paralelismo, nossa missão é desenvolver uma abordagem completamente nova para gerar significado e valor a partir de conjuntos de dados em escala de petabytes, além de criar metodologias, ferramentas, métodos estatísticos e modelos inovadores.

Além disso, trabalhamos em colaboração com acadêmicos de destaque, especialistas do setor e engenheiros altamente qualificados para capacitar nossos clientes a gerar insights sofisticados e inéditos a partir dos maiores volumes de big data.

Junte-se a nós para realizar o melhor trabalho da sua carreira e causar um impacto social profundo comoCientista de Dados Sênior na equipe de AI Centric Engineering no Brasil (remoto).

O que você irá alcançar

Como Cientista de Dados Sênior, você será responsável por liderar o desenho, desenvolvimento, fine-tuning e implantação de soluções avançadas de Inteligência Artificial Generativa e Ciência de Dados. Você trabalhará com equipes multifuncionais, líderes de negócios, engenheiros e especialistas de domínio para enfrentar desafios complexos de negócios, pesquisa e engenharia, transformando problemas ambíguos em soluções escaláveis que possam ser testadas, avaliadas e aplicadas em diferentes domínios.

Você irá:

  • Colaborar com equipes multifuncionais, líderes de negócios, engenheiros e especialistas de domínio para compreender requisitos complexos, definir soluções personalizadas de IA e Ciência de Dados e transformar desafios de negócios, pesquisa e engenharia em soluções escaláveis.
  • Liderar o desenvolvimento, fine-tuning, customização, avaliação e integração de modelos de linguagem de grande escala (LLMs), modelos pré-treinados e aplicações de IA Generativa para casos de uso específicos de negócios, pesquisa e indústria.
  • Aplicar técnicas avançadas de machine learning, processamento de linguagem natural (NLP), deep learning, métodos estatísticos e abordagens algorítmicas para aumentar a qualidade, confiabilidade e relevância dos modelos para o negócio.
  • Otimizar modelos e soluções analíticas para implantação em ambientes de nuvem, corporativos e com restrições de recursos, considerando desempenho, escalabilidade, custo e manutenibilidade.
  • Realizar testes, validações, monitoramento e avaliações rigorosas de desempenho das soluções de IA, incluindo aspectos relacionados à IA responsável, robustez e qualidade, além de fornecer orientação técnica, apoiar o compartilhamento de conhecimento e ajudar a estabelecer melhores práticas para entrega de soluções de IA Generativa e Ciência de Dados.

Dê o primeiro passo em direção à carreira dos seus sonhos

Cada membro da Dell Technologies traz algo único para a equipe. Veja o que buscamos para esta posição:

Requisitos Essenciais

  • Inglês avançado para interação constante com equipes e stakeholders internacionais, além de fortes habilidades de apresentação, especialmente para audiências executivas.
  • Bacharelado em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Inteligência Artificial, Estatística, Matemática, Física ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência comprovada com IA Generativa, incluindo LLMs, sistemas de IA Generativa e técnicas de processamento de linguagem natural; sólido entendimento dos conceitos de Ciência de Dados e IA Generativa; experiência com modelos de linguagem de grande escala; e familiaridade com técnicas e aplicações de NLP.
  • Fortes habilidades de programação em Python, proficiência em bibliotecas relevantes de machine learning e deep learning, familiaridade com ferramentas de desenvolvimento colaborativo (por exemplo, GitLab e Jira) e conhecimento dos conceitos fundamentais de projeto e análise de algoritmos.
  • Experiência sólida em fine-tuning, customização, avaliação e integração de modelos pré-treinados para aplicações específicas.

Requisitos Desejáveis

  • Pós-graduação stricto sensu, como Mestrado ou Doutorado em Inteligência Artificial, Machine Learning, Ciência de Dados ou áreas relacionadas, concluída ou em andamento.
  • Experiência na implantação de modelos e aplicações de IA em ambientes de produção, incluindo soluções corporativas ou baseadas em nuvem; conhecimento de práticas de IA ética, responsável e confiável, incluindo avaliação, mitigação de riscos, privacidade e equidade; e experiência com métodos avançados baseados em LLMs, sistemas agentic, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), frameworks de avaliação, MLOps ou LLMOps.

TWF has built the scaffolding for federal work. MBE certification, SAM.gov registration, two operational divisions ready to serve federal contracts, a credentialed bench, and signed commercial customers proving the operating model. What is missing is the capture function. This engagement is for the operator who knows how to walk a federal opportunity from first signal through awarded contract, and who wants to build that function inside a firm where it does not exist yet.

What is already built

The Wilkinson Firm is a workforce strategy and staffing firm headquartered across NC and Atlanta. We launched in April 2025 and are now in Year 2 of operations. Two operational divisions today (HR Advisory for the mental health industry, Premium Hospitality and Event Staffing). Government Contracting division being formally stood up this quarter. Three active staffing contracts in delivery. FY26 trajectory $425-525K. Zero loans, zero institutional debt. Defined path to $5M+ over the next 24 months.

Federal-relevant scaffolding:[- Two operational divisions ready to serve federal contracts in HHS-adjacent verticals (VA mental health programs, DoD behavioral health support, HHS workforce IDIQs) and hospitality (federal lodging, on-base food service, training facility F&B).

What you own

  • Federal opportunity identification and qualification across SAM.gov, GSA Schedules, agency forecasts, and prime/sub channels
  • Capture-to-proposal lifecycle: opportunity assessment, teaming strategy, technical and price strategy, color-team reviews, submission readiness
  • Capture playbook documentation: pursuit criteria, gate reviews, win themes, ghosting strategy, competitive analysis
  • Prime and sub partner relationships and government POC management
  • Set-aside strategy and certification work (8(a), HUBZone, WOSB, SDVOSB) in coordination with the GovCon Division Lead
  • Pipeline visibility and reporting to firm leadership
  • Coaching the Proposal Manager and Federal Account Executive seats as they come online

Engagement structure

Hourly consulting rate, three tiers calibrated to experience and scope:

  • Foundational ($100-200/hr): Capture managers with 5-8 years experience, ramping into a director role
  • Director ($200-350/hr): Established capture directors with documented win history on $1M+ contracts
  • Principal ($350-500/hr): Senior capture principals with multi-million-dollar award history and Tier 1 prime experience

Engagement is hourly. Time commitment scales with pipeline activity, typically 10-40 hours per week. Win-based bonus stack negotiable on top of hourly rate for awarded contracts the engagement materially drove.

Success milestones

  • Day 30: Capture playbook drafted. Pursuit gate criteria documented. Initial pipeline of 10+ qualified opportunities.
  • Day 90: 2-4 active captures in formal pursuit. First teaming agreements signed. Pipeline value $1M+.
  • Day 180: 2-4 proposals submitted. First award or shortlist position. Win rate baseline established.

Who you are

  • 7-15 years in federal capture, proposal management, or BD for small to mid-size GovCon firms
  • Documented track record capturing $1M+ federal contracts
  • Shipley-trained or equivalent. SAM.gov fluent. Comfortable with FAR/DFARS terminology
  • Familiar with small business set-asides and the certification lifecycle
  • Past performance citations in workforce, HHS-adjacent, hospitality, or staffing services preferred
  • Comfortable building a function from scratch inside a founder-led firm
  • Located in DC, NC, GA, or willing to travel to DC quarterly

Bonus points

  • Prior role at a Tier 1 GovCon prime or boutique capture firm
  • Existing relationships at DoD, VA, HHS, GSA, or DHS
  • APMP credential
  • Track record of managed HUBZone or 8(a) certifications

How we will get to know each other

  1. Initial 30-minute fit conversation with the GovCon Division Lead
  2. Working session: walk through a real federal opportunity or proposal scenario we are actively considering
  3. Reference checks (3+ professional references) and work history verification
  4. Engagement letter, scope of work, and rate confirmation
  5. Kickoff within 7 days of signed engagement

2-4 weeks first conversation to active engagement.

What we believe

Trust before revenue. Mission before money. Real seats, real upside. We build durable federal relationships through earned credibility. We win together. We pay people in real numbers, not pizza parties. We are building something great and we want partners who feel the same.

Application tips

  1. Visit , ,
  2. Find The Wilkinson Firm on LinkedIn
  3. In your cover note, answer two questions: (1) what kind of GovCon engagement model works best for you (project-based, retained hours, hybrid), and (2) one example of a federal pursuit, proposal, or account you would point to as your strongest reference work

What to expect from us

  • Reply within 48 hours
  • First-round conversation within 7 days of qualification
  • Full process: 2-4 weeks
  • We tell you yes or no. We do not ghost.

The Impact You Can Make

As an Oncology Data Specialist (ODS®), you will analyze all forms of medical records extracting clinical, pathological, therapeutic and epidemiologic data. Abstract and code all malignant and reportable benign conditions diagnosed and/or treated throughout the Glens Falls Hospital system for all pathologically or clinically diagnosed cases including imaging or cytology. Oncology data is a specialized field that supports cancer care without being on the front lines of patient care.

How You Will Fulfill Your Potential (Responsibilities)

  • Abstracting – Assign correct codes using all manuals, coding and staging schemas in current use. Thorough documentation to support coding choices. Must be able to recognize basic cell types for classification purposes. Analyze electronic & paper medical records, extract clinical, pathological, therapeutic and epidemiologic data according to established oncology data collection practices & standards. Accurately enters all information into the registry software in adherence with regulatory timeliness guidelines.

  • Follow-up – Continuous follow-up through the initiation of first course of treatment for thorough documentation of complete therapies planned and administered. Documentation to include reason no treatment when applicable.

  • Case finding / Accessioning – Determine if a case qualifies for accessioning using all manuals, coding and staging schemas in current use, prepare and abstract data on all patients receiving diagnosis and/or treatment care.

  • Cancer Program Support – Maintains the cancer registry in accordance with accepted ACoS CoC standards, NYSCR regulations, and GFH guidelines. Provides support for oncology case conference in the absence of the Oncology Data Management Coordinator.

  • Professional Development – obtain continuing education units as required to maintain ODS credential, participate in professional organizations, meetings and educational programs to advance knowledge and expertise in registry data management.

What You Bring (Qualifications)

  • Education: Minimum Associates degree required; Bachelor’s preferred. Continued education maintained for ODS credential per NYS DOH and CoC regulations.

  • Experience: Minimum 3 years of experience in related healthcare field or practicum in an NCRA accredited program.

    • Maintains patient confidentiality.
    • Knowledge of computer operations, MS Office Suite and current registry vendor software (ERS/CRStar).

We’re Personified: a managed IT + cybersecurity services provider for campaigns, non-profits, and mission-aligned organizations. Our mission is to lead technology and security programs for our clients, enabling them to focus on their mission-critical work.

We act as an extension of our client teams — we handle all the responsibilities a traditional internal IT team would. We are looking for top talent as we continue to scale our team.

As a Senior Technical Programs Manager, you will serve as a trusted partner and main point of contact for mission-driven clients, ensuring they receive responsive, high-quality IT and cybersecurity support. Clients will look to you for clear communication and reliable solutions, and you’ll build trust through proactive engagement, patience, and follow-through.

As part of this client-facing work, you will use your project management expertise to lead complex initiatives from scoping through execution. You’ll help define requirements and own project timelines in a fast-paced environment, coordinating across internal and external teams to ensure solutions are clearly documented and delivered on time and in scope.

You will work closely with the VP of Technical Programs and play a key role in client onboarding, ongoing account management, project scoping, internal process improvements, and team coordination.

If you have deep experience managing client relationships and excel at guiding complex projects while maintaining a spirit of collaboration and trust, we’d love to hear from you. Strategic Partnership and Internal Team Support
