OVERVIEW

The Company

U.S. Financial Technology (U.S. FinTech) is seeking an experienced Director of Cyber Security Operations to join our team of talented professionals. This is a full-time remote opportunity.

U.S. FinTech built and operates the largest and most advanced mortgage securitization platform in the world, supporting the Uniform Mortgage-Backed Security (UMBS) of Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac.

Supporting 70% of the mortgage-backed securities in the market, U.S. FinTech provides best-in-class single-family issuance, bond administration, disclosure, and tax services. We support a broad portfolio of products for our clients with full lifecycle management.

Our market-leading, cloud-based, end-to-end platform executes transactions on an extraordinary scale which has bolstered liquidity in the secondary mortgage market, one of the largest and most important financial markets in the world. Our unique approach to securitization combines the best minds in financial services with the know-how, flexibility, and innovation of leading technologists.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Job Information

The Director of Cyber Security Operations leads enterprise-wide security operations that protect the organization’s cloud-native and hybrid infrastructure, data, employee, and digital assets. This position is accountable for end-to-end cybersecurity monitoring, incident response, digital forensics, and supporting risk-reduction programs that preserve resilience and regulatory compliance. The role oversees advanced security architecture and tooling (SIEM, SOAR, AI/ML analytics), defines and reports organizational risk posture to executive leadership and regulators, and drives continuous innovation through process automation and technology modernization. This leader develops high-performing teams across monitoring, response, engineering, and cloud disciplines while integrating cybersecurity operations with enterprise IT and infrastructure functions to maintain audit-ready, financial-grade defenses.

Key Job Functions

  • Lead and mature enterprise-scale monitoring operations, including 24×7 Security Operations Center (SOC) oversight, real-time detection and alerting programs, telemetry optimization, and automation to reduce mean time to detect and respond.

  • Direct incident response and forensics programs, coordinating containment, eradication, and recovery across infrastructure and application domains while managing executive and regulatory communications during major security events.

  • Support risk-reduction initiatives encompassing vulnerability management, secure configuration baselines, patch governance, system integrity/authorized change, and compliance alignment for reduction in residual enterprise risk.

  • Architect and operationalize security platforms and analytics, implementing SIEM, SOAR, and AI/ML-driven tooling that enhance detection, automation, and response at enterprise scale.

  • Support cloud-native, hybrid and associated security operations, embedding DevSecOps practices, workload segmentation, and identity governance across cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP).

  • Define and report cyber-risk posture to executive leadership and regulatory bodies, aligning operational practices with enterprise risk frameworks and audit requirements.

  • Drive innovation and process automation in cybersecurity operations, evaluating emerging technologies to enhance predictive detection, orchestration, and operational efficiency.

  • Build, mentor, and lead high-performance cybersecurity teams across monitoring, response, engineering, and cloud disciplines, ensuring accountability and professional growth.

  • Integrate cybersecurity operations with infrastructure and IT processes, enforcing secure configuration standards, consistent baselines, and unified incident management workflows.

  • Represent the organization in audits, examinations, and crisis events, ensuring compliance with federal, financial, and industry-specific regulatory requirements.

QUALIFICATIONS

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or related field required; Advanced degrees (MS, PhD) strongly preferred.
  • Industry Certification required, e.g. GSOM, GSOC, CISSP, CISA, CISM or equivalent designation.

Minimum Experience

  • Minimum of 10 years experience:
    • Leading enterprise-scale monitoring operations, including 24×7 Security Operations Center management, real-time detection and alerting programs, “eyes-on-glass” analyst oversight, telemetry and log pipeline optimization, and the development of automated response processes to reduce mean time to detect and respond.
    • Directing comprehensive incident response and forensics functions, encompassing major incident handling, digital evidence collection, post-mortem analysis, executive and regulator engagement during breaches, and coordination with infrastructure and engineering teams to ensure containment and eradication of threats.
    • Architecting and operationalizinge advanced security platforms and tooling, including implementation of SIEM/SOAR systems, integration of AI/ML analytics into detection and response workflows, deployment of new enterprise-wide security solutions, and definition of long-term technical roadmaps for operational resilience.
  • Minimum of 6-10 years experience:
    • Managing enterprise-level risk-reduction programs, covering vulnerability management, compliance alignment, secure configuration baselining, patch governance, and audit remediation—driving measurable decreases in residual risk and ensuring adherence to regulatory and cybersecurity control frameworks.
    • Overseeing cloud-native cybersecurity operations, ensuring protection of workloads across cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP); embedding DevSecOps practices; maintaining compliance within virtualized and hybrid infrastructures; and governing identity, access, and workload isolation in dynamic cloud environments.
  • Applicants must be authorized to work in the US without requiring employer sponsorship currently or in the future. U.S. FinTech does not offer sponsorship for this position.

Specialized Knowledge & Skills

  • Deep expertise in Security Operations Center (SOC) design and management, including tiered analyst structures, alert triage workflows, and automated incident response orchestration.
  • Advanced proficiency in incident response leadership, including containment, eradication, digital forensics, and crisis communications with executive and regulatory stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to architect and maintain SIEM and SOAR platforms (e.g., Splunk, Power Automate, Scripting, KQL), optimizing correlation logic, enrichment pipelines, and playbook automation.
  • Strong knowledge of AI/ML integration in cybersecurity, including behavior-based analytics, anomaly detection, and large language model applications for threat hunting and automation.
  • Expertise in vulnerability management and risk reduction, including threat-based prioritization, patch lifecycle governance, secure configuration baselines, and exposure, and leveraging that information to drive threat and compromise detection.
  • Advanced understanding of secure cloud architecture and DevSecOps practices across AWS, Azure, and GCP, including workload isolation, zero-trust principles, and continuous compliance monitoring.
  • Proficiency in digital forensics and evidence preservation, including memory, disk, and network artifact analysis aligned to legal and regulatory standards.
  • Demonstrated capability to lead cybersecurity risk governance, mapping technical controls to NIST CSF, ISO 27001, SOC 2, and FHFA/Fed examination requirements, combined with strong understanding of regulatory and audit frameworks impacting fintech operations and enterprises.
  • Strong command of cybersecurity automation and orchestration frameworks, integrating endpoint, identity, and network telemetry into cohesive operational pipelines.
  • Strong knowledge in identity and access management (IAM), least-privilege enforcement, privileged-access controls, and integration with cloud-native identity providers.
  • Experience implementing and tuning data loss prevention (DLP), insider risk, and threat intelligence programs to detect anomalous user and data activity.
  • High fluency in security metrics and KPI development, including incident trends, dwell time analysis, patch compliance, and automation ROI reporting to executives.
  • Significant skills in cross-functional program leadership, aligning cybersecurity operations with IT, infrastructure, compliance, and product engineering teams.
  • Expertise in vendor and third-party risk management, including integration of external threat intelligence and performance monitoring.
  • Ability to design and execute enterprise cybersecurity testing and validation programs, including tabletop exercises, red team coordination, and control assurance.
  • Strong communication and executive presentation skills, translating technical risk into business impact for boards, regulators, and senior stakeholders.
  • Track record of innovation and continuous improvement, leveraging automation, ML/AI, and analytics to modernize cybersecurity operations at scale.
  • Exceptional leadership and team-building acumen, with the ability to recruit, mentor, and retain top technical talent across multiple cybersecurity domains.

Pay Range $208,500 to $235,750

U.S. FinTech's pay range for this job level is a general guideline only and not a guarantee of compensation or salary. Additional factors considered in extending an offer include (but are not limited to) a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as internal equity, alignment with market data, applicable bargaining agreement (if any), or other law. U.S. FinTech offers a competitive total compensation package, which includes a performance bonus, 401k match, healthcare coverage, PTO, and a broad range of other benefits.

Employment

As a condition of employment with U.S. Financial Technology, any successful job applicant will be required to successfully complete a background investigation, which may also include a credit check for positions in some areas of our business.

U.S. Financial Technology is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Understanding of MCP (Model Context Protocol) and agent tool-calling patterns

Prior experience shipping cross-platform desktop applications

Government Affairs Consultant (Germany)

6-Month Contract | Part-Time Consultancy (2-3 Days Per Week)

Location: Germany. Berlin preferred; Baden-Württemberg, Bavaria, North Rhine-Westphalia also suitable. Regular travel to Berlin, Bonn and selected university-hospital/policy hubs expected.

What We're Seeking

Oxford Nanopore is seeking an experienced Government Affairs Consultant to lead our policy engagement and stakeholder strategy in Germany on a part-time consultancy basis. This is a unique opportunity for a well-connected health policy professional to help shape the environment for the adoption of innovative genomic technologies within one of Europe's most influential healthcare markets.

The successful consultant will bring deep knowledge of the German healthcare and policymaking landscape, with the ability to engage credibly across government, self-governance bodies, clinical networks, patient organisations and industry associations. Working closely with our Global and EMEA Government Affairs teams, you will help position Oxford Nanopore as a trusted partner in the development of genomic medicine, health-data infrastructure and future reimbursement pathways.

We are particularly interested in individuals who understand the intersection of healthcare policy, diagnostics, genomics and innovation, and who are motivated by the opportunity to support the integration of next-generation sequencing technologies into clinical practice across rare disease, oncology and pathogen genomics.

Key Responsibilities

  • Strategy and positioning: Develop the Germany government affairs plan and policy narrative for nanopore sequencing in genomic medicine, health-data infrastructure, reimbursement and preparedness.
  • Stakeholder engagement: Build compliant relationships with priority federal, self-governance, Länder, trade-association, clinical-network and patient stakeholders, including BfArM/genomDE/MV GenomSeq, G-BA/IQWiG and VDGH.
  • Policy intelligence: Monitor § 64e SGB V, genomDE, GDNG/FDZ Gesundheit, EHDS, IVDR, ePA and reimbursement developments; summarise implications, risks and opportunities.
  • Evidence and access: Support Market Access, Medical/Clinical Affairs, Regulatory and technical teams on evidence gaps, validation requirements and policy barriers in rare disease, oncology and pathogen genomics.
  • External representation: Support agreed policy forums, association work, stakeholder briefs, meeting readouts, roundtables, consultation inputs and position papers, in conjunction with central Government Affairs team.
  • Compliance and reporting: Maintain stakeholder maps, engagement trackers and monthly intelligence notes; ensure activities follow Oxford Nanopore policies, German transparency requirements and Legal/Compliance review.

Experience:

Essential
  • Native or fluent German speaker with strong English
  • Significant experience in German health policy/government affairs
  • Strong understanding of Germany’s healthcare system, including federal/Länder structure and key decision-making bodies
  • Proven ability to credibly engage with public institutions, clinicians, and scientific stakeholders
Desirable
  • Experience in genomics, diagnostics, or precision medicine
  • Familiarity with key frameworks (e.g. §64e SGB V, G-BA/IQWiG processes, genomDE, EHDS)
  • Existing network across government, policy and to some extent university hospitals, research institutes, or relevant agencies
  • Understanding of the wider EU policy landscape and the role of Brussels

Success Measures

  • Evidence of ONT engagement within key policy and government stakeholders
  • Development of a credible German political stakeholder network supporting ONT use cases
  • Contribution to positioning ONT as a trusted partner in German genomics infrastructure

Why This Role Matters

Germany is an institution-led market where clinical adoption depends on validation, governance, and reimbursement systems rather than commercial access alone. This role is therefore critical to ensuring ONT is embedded within the structures that define long-term clinical scale.

Senior UE5 Technical Artist, Defcon Zero | TriArts Games | Remote

Join the team building Defcon Zero, a high-fidelity RTS powered by Unreal Engine 5.

We are looking for a Senior Technical Artist to join our technical art team, working on scalable materials, production tools, asset integration, and real-time optimization inside Unreal Engine 5. You will bridge the gap between art and development, helping our units, structures, environments, and battlefield effects meet high visual standards while remaining performant at RTS scale.

You will have direct ownership, work closely with both artists and developers, and see your work reflected throughout the final game.

What you'll own

  • Performance and optimization: Profile and optimize materials, geometry, textures, lighting, shadows, foliage, and visual effects for large-scale RTS battles.
  • Materials and shaders: Build scalable materials and shaders supporting faction colors, damage states, construction effects, and gameplay-driven visuals.
  • Art pipeline: Build reliable workflows between Maya, Substance Painter, and Unreal Engine 5 for asset preparation, importing, validation, and automation.
  • Tools development: Create tools and scripts that reduce repetitive work and improve iteration speed for artists and designers.
  • Environment systems: Develop workflows for landscapes, foliage, instancing, procedural placement, and level assembly across RTS camera distances.
  • Gameplay visual integration: Connect art and effects to gameplay, including construction, destruction, damage feedback, abilities, and world-space indicators.
  • Destruction systems: Build and optimize destruction for vehicles, structures, and environments using Chaos and other techniques, covering fracturing, damage states, debris, and effects.
  • Visual effects support: Help VFX artists integrate, troubleshoot, and optimize Niagara systems and materials while maintaining gameplay readability.
  • Technical problem-solving: Resolve rendering, shading, lighting, geometry, texture, import, and performance issues across the art pipeline.
  • Standards and documentation: Define asset budgets, naming conventions, material and LOD guidelines, validation checks, and production documentation.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional technical art experience in games.
  • Strong Unreal Engine 5 experience in asset integration, rendering, and production tools.
  • Advanced knowledge of the Material Editor, master materials, material instances, and shader optimization.
  • Strong understanding of lighting, shadows, geometry, texture memory, draw calls, shader complexity, and overdraw.
  • Hands-on experience profiling and resolving performance bottlenecks in Unreal Engine.
  • Experience with LODs, instancing, culling, and scalability settings.
  • Hands-on Chaos Destruction experience, including Geometry Collections, fracturing, clustering, physics fields, and runtime optimization.
  • Hands-on experience integrating and implementing VFX in Unreal Engine 5, including Niagara systems and runtime performance optimization.﻿
  • Experience integrating art and visual systems with gameplay alongside developers.
  • Working knowledge of Blueprints, HLSL, C++, or Unreal Engine editor plugins.﻿
  • Experience with Unreal Engine's PCG framework, landscapes, and large-scale foliage.﻿﻿
  • Able to work independently and collaborate with artists, animators, designers, and developers.
  • At least one shipped game with a significant personal contribution.
  • Fluent in written and spoken English.

Nice to have

  • Experience with Houdini, and procedural pipelines.
  • Knowledge of Maya and Substance Painter workflows, including topology, UVs, baking, and texture preparation.﻿
  • Tool development and automation experience using Python, editor scripting, or similar solutions.
  • Experience creating real-time VFX using Niagara, including weapon effects, explosions, abilities, and environmental effects.
  • Experience evaluating and optimizing Nanite, Lumen, and Virtual Shadow Maps.
  • Experience with RTS, strategy, or high-unit-count games.
  • A passion for RTS games.

Who you are

  • You understand both art and technology.
  • You turn visual goals into reliable, scalable technical solutions.
  • You balance visual quality, gameplay readability, and performance.
  • You identify problems early and take ownership of solutions.
  • You debug methodically, validate improvements through profiling, and communicate clearly.
  • You build tools around the needs of their users.
  • You collaborate proactively and welcome constructive feedback.
  • You independently learn and introduce new tools, workflows, and methods.

What we offer

  • The Forefront of PC Development: Join one of Israel's few studios building a high-fidelity, hardcore PC strategy game in Unreal Engine 5.
  • Fully Remote: Work remotely with clear communication, personal ownership, and focused collaboration.
  • A Veteran Team: Work with experienced developers and artists who share a passion for RTS and high production standards.
  • Growth Potential: Expand your influence, ownership, and responsibility as the studio and Defcon Zero grow.
  • Direct Impact: Shape the game's visuals, performance, and production through your tools and technical solutions.
  • Collaborative Culture: Join a friendly, dedicated team committed to the professional standards needed to ship a top-tier game.

jobs.excerpt: ABOUT SINCHSinch is pioneering the way the world communicates.
jobs.description:
ABOUT SINCH

Sinch is pioneering the way the world communicates. More than 150,000 businesses — including Google, Uber, Paypal, Visa, Tinder, and many others — rely on Sinch's Customer Communications Cloud to power engaging customer experiences through mobile messaging, voice, and email.

Whether you need to verify users or craft omnichannel campaigns, Sinch makes it easy. Our AI-infused Super Network, APIs, and applications ensure you can connect with your customers reliably and securely, at every step of their journey.

At Sinch we "Dream Big", "Win Together", "Keep it simple", and "Make it Happen". These values are our foundation!

DESCRIPTION

The Customer Experience Analytics (CXA) team is an enablement team: we sit between how product data is created and how it's consumed across the company. On the creation side, we help Product and Engineering teams define event schemas and taxonomy so that data is generated consistently and reliably from the source. On the consumption side, we help other teams use that data in a simple, self-service way. In between, we own data quality, governance, and monitoring — making sure data stays trustworthy from creation to consumption.

This is a mid-level role. We're not looking for someone who already has every tool or years of polished experience — we're looking for someone with solid analytical fundamentals who is genuinely motivated to learn, adapts quickly, and takes ownership of problems until they're resolved. You'll grow into the specifics of our stack; what matters most is how you think and how you work.

You'll work with global teams across time zones, partnering with Product Managers, Engineering Managers, Software Engineers, and Customer Success. Our stack today includes RudderStack, Snowflake, dbt, and Tableau, and we're migrating toward BigQuery and Looker — but familiarity with these specific tools is not a requirement (more on that below).

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Data Quality & Schema Governance: Help define, document, and evolve event schemas and tracking plans. Monitor data quality end-to-end, investigate issues from a metric back to its source, and support the lifecycle process for new and deprecated events.
  • Self-Service Enablement: Build and maintain data models, dashboards, and documentation that let Product, Engineering, and other stakeholders answer their own questions without depending on our team for every request.
  • Pipeline & Data Modeling: Create and maintain clean, reliable, well-tested data models that other teams and downstream tools can depend on.
  • Behavioral & Customer Journey Analysis: Use SQL and product analytics tools to help map user behavior and the customer journey when it's needed to support a schema, quality, or enablement decision — this is part of the job, not the primary focus of it.
  • Cross-Team Collaboration: Act as a reliable point of contact for Product and Engineering teams on data definitions, event tracking questions, and governance decisions.
  • Data Culture: Train stakeholders to use self-serve analytics tools autonomously, and help spread good data practices across the organization.

REQUIREMENTS

  • Some experience in Data Analytics, Analytics Engineering, or a similar role — we care more about your ability to learn fast and take ownership than about years of experience.
  • Solid SQL fundamentals, with the ability to reason about schemas and data structure, not just write queries.
  • Comfortable learning new tools quickly; you don't need prior experience with our specific stack.
  • Strong ownership mindset: you take on problems, work through them independently, and know when and how to ask for help when you're stuck.
  • Genuine curiosity about data quality, taxonomy, and how data is structured "under the hood" — not just about the insights on top of it.
  • A bachelor's degree in a quantitative or business-related subject (e.g., Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, Economics, or similar) — or equivalent practical experience.
  • Advanced fluency in English, both verbal and written.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Exposure to event-driven tracking, product event architecture, or Customer Data Platforms (e.g., RudderStack, Segment).
  • Hands-on experience with dbt, BigQuery, Looker and similar tools.
  • Experience mapping or analyzing the customer journey (funnels, retention, cohort analysis).
  • Experience working in a global company across multiple time zones.
  • Telecom, CPaaS, or B2B SaaS experience.
  • Advanced fluency in English, both verbal and written.

BENEFITS

  • Stay Healthy: We cover 100% of medical and dental plans for Sinchers and eligible dependents through Bradesco Saúde.
  • Flexible Benefits: With the Caju flexible benefit card, our Sinchers can choose to use benefits on food, education, and home office assistance.
  • Family First: Our Sinchers can enjoy paid maternity leave for 180 days and paternity leave for 30 days. Plus, we provide daycare assistance for kids up to five years old.
  • Everyday Wellbeing: We partner with Wellhub to help Sinchers access gyms and wellness options.
  • Secure Your Future:Our Partnership with Prudential life insurance provides coverage for all Sinchers in the events of unexpected absences, serious illness, accidents, and disabilities.
  • Diversity and Inclusion: We offer annual reimbursements for certain expenses related to disabilities and/or transgender needs.
  • Take a Break: Our Sinchers can take a day off on their birthday to celebrate with their loved ones.

OUR HIRING PROCESS

We are committed to ensuring a recruitment process that is fair, objective, consistent, and inclusive. Our approach includes structured, competency-based interviews designed to evaluate your skills, experience, and qualifications relevant to the role. At times, we may include a data-driven assessment to enhance our hiring success and identify candidates likely to excel.

We believe in a two-way process and encourage you to ask questions throughout the journey. If this role isn't what you're looking for, please explore the other opportunities listed on our career page: No matter who you are, we hope you find an exciting path forward - hopefully with us!

Align KYC practices with enterprise risk frameworks

Drive automation and digital transformation in KYC processes

Ensure integration with AML and transaction monitoring systems

jobs.excerpt: Assigning Editor: Social & Viral NewsAbout The Mary Sue and We Got This CoveredThe Mary Sue and We Got This Covered are looking for a highly skilled and motivated assigning editor to take our story sourcing, pitching, and article curation to the next level, with a focus on social-first stories and syndicated news.
jobs.description:
Assigning Editor: Social & Viral News

About The Mary Sue and We Got This Covered

The Mary Sue and We Got This Covered are looking for a highly skilled and motivated assigning editor to take our story sourcing, pitching, and article curation to the next level, with a focus on social-first stories and syndicated news.

We cover everything from major political news to the latest celebrity drama and the week’s biggest streaming hits. We also tell real stories about real people, like an everyday post on social media that hasn't yet caught anyone else's attention. This variety is the key to our success, and the right candidate should be comfortable sourcing and pitching engaging stories from all corners of the internet as well as major mainstream news.

We aim to share stories with our audience that really get them thinking, talking, and sharing them organically rather than relying on traditional SEO. We want someone who is excited about doing things a little differently and has a hunger for finding the next big story.

About The Role

As the Assigning Editor, you will be in charge of the first, and one of the most crucial, steps when it comes to formulating an engaging or thought-provoking article. You’ll lead story sourcing and pitching for our social and viral news desk across multiple brands and spend much of your day digging into the major news stories that people really care about or on TikTok (as well as Reddit and other social media platforms), spotting posts and conversations that have the makings of a big story. To excel, you’ll have a natural ability to spot the story in something that others would scroll straight past and know how to frame it so it reaches a wide audience.

This is a fast-paced, high-volume role, which will best fit someone who is comfortable pitching a large number of stories every day while using data (and natural instinct) to inform decisions over time.

What You'll Do

  • Keep abreast of major world events, the latest news in the world of entertainment, and understand how to frame these topics in new and interesting ways that will resonate with our audiences
  • Monitor TikTok and other social platforms every day to find stories, ideally before other publishers do
  • Write clear pitches and context to give writers everything they need before starting on an article
  • Assign stories to staff and freelance writers
  • Frame stories and headlines for syndication and social platforms like MSN, Facebook, and SmartNews
  • Track performance and use data to refine your pitches
  • Build and document discovery workflows, so writers and other editors can become stronger pitchers
  • Verify that stories are accurate, credit creators properly, and treat the people in our stories fairly
  • Work with the wider editorial team to spot stories that deserve extra attention, follow-ups, or investigation

What We're Looking For

  • Experience as an assigning, commissioning, news, trending, or social editor in a fast-moving digital media environment (or extensive experience as a self-pitching writer)
  • A genuine love for the weird and wonderful worlds of TikTok and social culture, with a strong instinct for what people will want to read and a passion for exploring new niches
  • Syndication and/or social media experience is a strong plus
  • Excellent, compelling headline writing without being misleading
  • Comfortable working with traffic data and using it to guide editorial decisions
  • An ability to work in a fast-paced, high-volume pitching environment
  • A strong understanding of ethical journalism
  • A strong understanding of US culture and audiences

Think you can spot the next big story before anyone else? Please send us your resume, along with a cover letter that tells us who you are and what makes you a good fit for this role. We'd also love to see three social posts or stories you've come across recently that you think would make a great article, with a headline for each and a line on why you picked it.

Equal Opportunities

The Mary Sue and We Got This Covered are committed to being inclusive and welcoming places to work. We encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, including but not limited to race, ethnicity, national origin, age, disability, religion, gender identity and expression, and sexual orientation. LGBTQI+ candidates are warmly welcomed and encouraged to apply.

jobs.excerpt: OverviewPaige Renewable Energy, a GCG company, is seeking an experienced Electrical Design Estimator to join our growing Paige Energy team and support utility-scale renewable energy projects across North America!
jobs.description:
Overview

Paige Renewable Energy, a GCG company, is seeking an experienced Electrical Design Estimator to join our growing Paige Energy team and support utility-scale renewable energy projects across North America!

As our Electrical Estimator, you’ll translate customer drawings, specifications, bills of material, and project requirements into accurate, executable estimates. You’ll perform detailed material takeoffs, develop project pricing, identify scope or design issues, and work closely with Sales, Engineering, Project Management, Supply Chain, and manufacturing partners to help ensure projects are positioned for successful execution.

This is a strong opportunity for someone who combines practical electrical knowledge with exceptional attention to detail and ownership. You should be comfortable working through large, complex project packages, asking thoughtful technical questions, challenging assumptions when something does not look right, and taking responsibility for the accuracy and completeness of your work.

While this role offers a remote work environment, we are seeking candidates in either the Eastern or Central Time Zone to align with the work schedule of the existing team.

What You’ll Do

  • Review RFQ packages, electrical drawings, site layouts, single-line diagrams, specifications, bills of material, and related documentation to understand project scope and requirements.

  • Perform detailed electrical material takeoffs, including cable lengths, harness and string counts, connectors, assemblies, accessories, and other project-specific materials.

  • Develop project estimates incorporating material costs, vendor pricing, freight, manufacturing costs, customer requirements, and other project-specific considerations.

  • Identify drawing discrepancies, missing information, scope gaps, incompatible materials, and other potential risks while clearly documenting assumptions, exclusions, and required clarifications.

  • Validate critical quantities, material selections, calculations, and drawing revisions before estimates are released.

  • Coordinate with Supply Chain and manufacturing partners to obtain and validate supplier pricing, lead times, freight requirements, and other cost inputs.

  • Support proposal development, design revisions, value-engineering opportunities, Best and Final Offer (BAFO) activities, and estimate revisions throughout the sales process.

  • Evaluate changes between estimate revisions and clearly communicate impacts to quantities, scope, cost, materials, and project requirements.

  • Maintain organized, traceable estimating files and supporting documentation that allow estimates to be independently reviewed.

  • Participate in project award and handoff activities, confirming that final estimates, quantities, assumptions, pricing, and scope align with the awarded project and customer purchase order.

  • Support estimating needs related to project changes, additional material requests, spare parts, and change orders.

  • Help improve estimating templates, tools, checklists, standards, and review processes by incorporating lessons learned from awarded and completed projects.

What You’ll Bring

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of electrical estimating experience, or equivalent electrical construction or design experience that includes estimating and material takeoff responsibilities.

  • Demonstrated ability to read and interpret electrical drawings, single-line diagrams, site plans, specifications, and bills of material.

  • Experience performing detailed material takeoffs and developing project estimates.

  • Strong understanding of electrical materials, cable, conductors, connectors, and electrical distribution systems.

  • Strong mathematical and analytical skills with a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and experience using Bluebeam or similar takeoff and document-review software.

  • Strong organizational, communication, and collaboration skills with the ability to manage multiple complex estimates at different stages of development.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with renewable energy, utility-scale solar, EPC organizations, electrical contracting, or industrial electrical projects.

  • Proficiency with AutoCAD.

  • Working knowledge of the National Electrical Code (NEC).

  • Education in Electrical Engineering, Electrical Technology, Construction Management, or a related technical discipline; equivalent relevant industry experience will also be considered.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means producing estimates that are accurate, complete, timely, and traceable.

You’ll take ownership of your work, identify inconsistencies and risks before they become costly problems, clearly communicate assumptions and technical concerns, and help projects transition smoothly from opportunity through award and execution. You’ll also contribute to improving the tools and processes the Paige Energy team uses to make estimating increasingly efficient and reliable.

What We Offer

  • Competitive base salary ranging from $80,000 to $90,000 plus annual bonus based on company and individual performance

  • Comprehensive Health Coverage: Multiple medical plan options (CDHP and PPO) to get you the coverage you need
  • Robust Financial Security: Company-paid life and disability insurance, 401(k) with company match, plus options for supplemental critical illness, accident, and hospital indemnity plans
  • Generous Time Off: PTO plan with paid holidays, paid parental leave, and paid compassionate care leave to support personal well-being and family needs
  • Wellness & Support Programs: Employee Assistance Program (EAP), wellness incentives, and telehealth access
  • Extras That Matter: Dental and vision plans, FSAs/HSAs with company contributions, pet insurance, legal services, and ID theft protection for peace of mind
  • An employee-centric company that values and truly appreciates our most important asset: You!

About Paige

Paige, a GCG company, has been delivering innovative wire and cable solutions for over 65 years. Serving industries including renewable energy, data communications, industrial applications, irrigation, and more, we are committed to engineering excellence, customer-driven innovation, and high-quality products that help businesses solve complex challenges with tailored solutions.

Built on a foundation of expertise, flexibility, and humility, we are dedicated to solving customer challenges, adapting to their needs, and continuously improving. At Paige, we remove ego from the equation, fostering a collaborative, customer-focused culture that drives long-term growth, innovation, and enduring partnerships.

Join us and be part of a company shaping the future of connectivity.

About GCG

At GCG, our mission is to power, connect, and automate our world. With the responsive DNA of a startup and the size of a global leader, we offer top brands and extensive value-added services that make us an invaluable partner to our customers in multiple industry verticals across the globe.

We are committed to meeting the needs of our customers, while focusing attention on our responsibility to the environment, our associates and the communities we serve.

The Wilkinson Firm (TWF) is an enterprise workforce strategy and staffing firm. Two divisions today: HR Advisory for the mental health industry and Premium Hospitality Staffing. Partnership structure (LLC member with profit distributions)

This is a partnership role, not an employment role. You join as an LLC member with a defined membership interest. Cross-division CRO membership lives either at the holding-co level or pro-rata across division LLCs, negotiable based on revenue allocation.

The membership interest tiers are the headline. Tier 3 (3-8%) grants at hire if you clear a 6-month trial against the 5-gate evaluation. Tier 4 (8-15%, true partner level) progresses at month 18-24 with sustained firm-wide revenue performance. Vesting runs four years with a one-year cliff. Zero institutional debt means no forced dilution from future investor rounds, so your membership stays your membership.

Profit distributions flow quarterly, proportional to membership. Direct attribution adds 3-5% override on total firm revenue and 5-10% on revenue you directly sourced. Bonus stack: $25,000 at first $1M ARR milestone, $50,000 at $2.5M ARR, $100,000 at $5M ARR.

Guaranteed monthly distributions are the honest read on cash. We're a startup. Day 1-90 is $0 while you ramp on revenue attribution + membership vesting. Months 3-4, $3,000-$5,000/month activates once first division-wide revenue uplift is measurable. Months 6-12, $5,000-$10,000/month at $750K+ firm-wide attributable revenue. Year 1 OTE at target performance: $100,000-$250,000 cash + membership vesting.

Tax structure is K-1, not W-2. Self-employment tax applies. Talk to your CPA before signing. The founder takes no guaranteed monthly distributions today either. We share the upside as members.

jobs.excerpt: NOTE: This is a remote position; CRS will only consider candidates who are based in countries where we have existing offices.
jobs.description:
NOTE: This is a remote position; CRS will only consider candidates who are based in countries where we have existing offices.

Job Summary

The Supply Chain Management Technical Advisor II will provide technical support, accompaniment, and training to EMPOWER partners in South America to strengthen supply chain and operational preparedness for rapid emergency response.

The Supply Chain Management Technical Advisor II will work with EMPOWER partners to improve their supply chain preparedness and response capacities so that can set up and operate multiple modality supply chains (in kind and CVA) in an expedited manner.

This includes the following five priority focuses:

1) Updated specifications--Adjusting relief item/kit specifications and CVA transfer amounts to match latest technical recommendations, that are appropriate to the context, and which are available/possible in the local market;

2) Strategic sourcing--Exploring local markets to identify best output value suppliers (quality, delivery and price) for key relief items/kits and cash voucher assistance modalities (via financial and mobile service providers);

3) Prepositioned stocks--Establishing prepositioned stocks of key relief items in countries where it is hard to find them locally to the desired specifications (i.e. stored value cards, vouchers, humanitarian grade tarps, light and charge solar lanterns, and water purification tablets/satchels);

4) Open contracts--Setting up indefinite quantity contracts (open contracts/framework agreements) with best suppliers identified for key relief items/kits and CVA modalities; and

5) Continuous improvement—Supporting partners to identify ways they can improve their procurement, inventory management, logistics and distribution processes, tools and capabilities so they can enhance efficiency and responsiveness.

The role will work closely with partners and relevant CRS teams to identify and close priority bottlenecks, test readiness systems, and enable partners to procure, contract, transport, store, and distribute assistance quickly, responsibly, and in compliance with applicable standards.

Roles and Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the multiple modality supply chain set up process in all five target countries in close coordination with partner supply chain teams focusing on the whole supply chain from procurement to inventory management, and then planning for logistics and distributions when responses activated.
  • Make sure that all five priority focuses are executed as intended: updated specifications, strategic sourcing, prepositioned stocks, open contracts, and continuous improvement.
  • Support programming team with market and logistics analysis, hotspot prioritization, stakeholder mapping, and development of a workplan and deliverable calendar.
  • Work with technical leads and partners to establish minimum quality standards, packing guidance, replenishment requirements, quality-control processes, and substitution rules.
  • Validate priority kit contents against local market availability, cultural appropriateness, hazard scenarios, packaging needs, and branding and visibility expectations.
  • Collect and verify market prices and develop country-, hot spot-, remote-area- specific kit costing matrices that account for transport, handling, storage, customs or importation, last-mile delivery, supplier lead times, and other key cost drivers.
  • Map, assess, conduct due diligence on, and support prequalification of suppliers, transporters, warehouse providers, packaging providers, and other service providers, including backup suppliers and alternative sourcing options for key items.
  • Develop and maintain vendor databases and prequalified vendor lists organized by country, hotspot, sector, commodity group, and service type, with clear ownership, review frequency, renewal dates, and documentation requirements.
  • Support partners and relevant CRS functions to prepare or update open contracts, framework agreements, standby supplier agreements, emergency procurement templates, and associated contracting-readiness files.
  • Map and assess financial and mobile service providers for cash and voucher assistance, including geographic coverage, transfer modalities, fees, liquidity, surge capacity, compliance, data protection, reporting capacity, and humanitarian experience.
  • Support financial and mobile service provider contracting readiness and partner protocols for activation, secure data transfer, reconciliation, complaints handling, and failed-payment procedures.
  • Assess partner procurement, contracting, warehousing, inventory management, transport, distribution, documentation, segregation-of-duties, and quality-assurance processes; facilitate practical improvements to close priority gaps.
  • Provide guidance on warehouse requirements by inventory type, stock security, inventory systems, storage practices, and readiness for safe and orderly in-kind distributions, including relevant manuals and procedures.
  • Map regional land, sea, and air shipping routes and options for partners operating across multiple countries, including arrangements for inter-country movement of relief items where applicable.
  • Develop partner-specific readiness checklists and action plans with defined actions, responsible persons, deadlines, support needs, approvals, compliance risks, contingency arrangements, escalation points, and maintenance responsibilities.

Reports to: GovCon Division Lead, with dotted line to the Federal Capture Director.

A note from the founder

A great proposal is the difference between a captured opportunity and an awarded contract. We have the capture motion ramping up. We need the operator who turns the captured opportunity into a compliant, compelling, on-time response, and who builds the response library so every future proposal moves faster than the last.

What is already built

The Wilkinson Firm is a workforce strategy and staffing firm headquartered across NC and Atlanta. We launched in April 2025 and are now in Year 2 of operations. Two operational divisions today (HR Advisory for the mental health industry, Premium Hospitality and Event Staffing). Government Contracting division being formally stood up this quarter. Three active staffing contracts in delivery. FY26 trajectory $425-525K. Zero loans, zero institutional debt.

Bench credentials: Former EEOC Administrative Law Judge, employment attorneys (JD, MBA), clinical advisors, 32-year enterprise operations specialist. 47 combined years HHS experience.

What you own

  • Full proposal lifecycle: kickoff, compliance matrix, schedule, color-team reviews (pink, red, gold), production, submission
  • Technical writing and editing across executive summary, technical approach, management approach, past performance, and resumes of key personnel
  • Compliance matrix ownership: every shall, every Section L and M requirement, every page count, every font and margin spec
  • Response library build: past performance citations, key personnel resumes, technical narratives, reusable management approach modules, pricing structures
  • Coordination with the Federal Capture Director on win themes, discriminators, and ghosting strategy
  • Coordination with subcontractor partners on teaming inputs and price submissions
  • Post-submission tracking, debrief capture, and lessons-learned documentation

Engagement structure

Hourly consulting rate, three tiers calibrated to experience and scope:

  • Writer ($100-175/hr): Proposal writers and coordinators with 3-7 years federal proposal experience
  • Manager ($175-325/hr): Proposal managers with documented win history and full-lifecycle ownership
  • Principal ($325-500/hr): Senior proposal directors with multi-million-dollar award history and Tier 1 prime experience

Engagement is hourly. Per-proposal scope and budget defined at proposal kickoff. Win-based bonus stack negotiable on top of hourly rate for proposals that result in awarded contracts.

Success milestones

  • First 60 days: Proposal process documented. Compliance matrix template built. Response library framework established with 5+ reusable past performance citations.
  • First 120 days: First 1-2 proposals submitted on time, compliant, and competitive. Color-team review cadence established.
  • First 180 days: 3-5 proposals submitted. First award or shortlist position. Response library covers 80% of TWF's standard content needs.

Who you are

  • 5-15 years in federal proposal management, technical writing, or capture support
  • Documented track record managing $1M+ federal proposals through full lifecycle to submission
  • Shipley-trained or equivalent. APMP credential preferred
  • Fluent in FAR/DFARS, RFP structure (Sections L and M), and compliance matrix methodology
  • Strong writing voice: clear, persuasive, and adaptable across technical and management content
  • Comfortable working both as lead writer and as orchestrator of subject matter expert input
  • Past performance citations in workforce services, HHS programs, hospitality contracting, or staffing IDIQs preferred
  • Located anywhere in the US

Bonus points

  • Prior role at a Tier 1 GovCon prime or boutique proposal shop
  • Experience with VA, HHS, DoD behavioral health, or federal hospitality contracts
  • Pricing strategy fluency (cost narrative, BOEs, indirect rate structures)
  • Experience standing up a proposal function inside an emerging GovCon firm

How we will get to know each other

  1. Initial 30-minute fit conversation with the GovCon Division Lead
  2. Working session: walk through a real proposal scenario we are actively considering or recently submitted
  3. Reference checks (3+ professional references) and work history verification
  4. Engagement letter, scope of work, and rate confirmation
  5. Kickoff within 7 days of signed engagement

What we believe

Trust before revenue. Mission before money. Real seats, real upside. We build durable federal relationships through earned credibility. We win together. We pay people in real numbers, not pizza parties.

Application tips

  1. Visit , ,
  2. Find The Wilkinson Firm on LinkedIn
  3. In your cover note, answer two questions: (1) what's the engagement shape that works best for you (project-based, retained hours, hybrid), and (2) one example of a federal proposal you would point to as your strongest reference work

What to expect from us

  • Reply within 48 hours
  • First-round conversation within 7 days of qualification
  • Full process: 2-4 weeks

About the Role

We are looking for a detail-oriented Invoice Processing Specialist to manage and verify invoices associated with medical records requests.

In this role, you will review incoming invoices, match them to the appropriate requests, verify amounts and payment requirements, process payments, and resolve discrepancies or disputes. The position requires strong numerical accuracy, attention to detail, and the ability to identify potential duplicate or fraudulent payment requests.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage the Invoice Queue: Review and process incoming invoices daily, prioritizing overdue items and time-sensitive requests.
  • Match and Verify Invoices: Confirm patient, provider, record type, invoice details, and payment amounts before processing.
  • Identify Duplicates: Review potential duplicate or near-match invoices and verify whether they represent legitimate charges before payment.
  • Apply Payment Limits and Requirements: Process payments within approved limits and route amounts exceeding authorized limits for the appropriate approval.
  • Review Fees: Identify potentially incorrect or disallowed fees and initiate the appropriate dispute or escalation process.
  • Process Payments: Make payments through credit card, online provider portals, prepayment systems, mailed checks, or other approved methods.
  • Resolve Payment Disputes: Follow up on duplicate charges, incorrect fees, refunds, or other payment issues and maintain clear documentation of each resolution.
  • Maintain Payment Records: Keep accurate records of invoices, payments, disputes, approvals, and related communications.
  • Verify Payment Information: Follow established procedures to verify changes to vendor payment details using trusted contact information before processing payments.
  • Follow Internal Procedures: Ensure all payments and invoice-processing activities follow established approval, documentation, and security procedures.

Required Qualifications

  • Strong numerical accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Excellent written English with the ability to create clear and concise notes.

Backend & Integrations

Frontend

  • Contribute to Angular UI components for WorkPro modules as needed.

  • Support role-based UI flows for dispatchers, managers, and field technicians.

Team & Delivery

  • Work with a Product Owner to deliver features in tight, iterative cycles.

  • Participate in code reviews, sprint planning, and production deployments.

  • Experience with Dynamics 365, Power Automate, or Logic Apps.

  • Build and quality tooling: Maven/Gradle, pip/poetry, NuGet, Go modules, SonarQube, static analysis.

  • Deeper experience with AI-assisted development or LLM-backed workflows (prompt engineering, RAG, agentic tooling).

This is a unique opportunity that offers a chance to make a real difference in the lives of millions of students across the country. This position requires focus and dedication to make quick and accurate decisions on repetitive work.

This team is credited with uncovering bullying, threats of violence, suicide attempts, self-harm situations, domestic abuse, mental health struggles, drug abuse, and many other situations where a student needs intervention from a caring adult.

What you will be doing

  • Reviewing and analyzing student activity to identify a need for intervention related to student safety or well-being while maintaining quality and efficiency goals set in place to ensure quick delivery of actionable information to emergency contacts
  • Communicating with our customers, designated emergency contacts, at a school district to relay important information
  • Fielding phone calls and emails from customers about student incidents in a responsive, resourceful, and professional manner
  • Applying sound judgment and knowledge from previous related experience to make the best decisions to keep students safe
  • Recording and maintaining concise notes regarding each incident in Salesforce CRM
  • Identifying trends, utilizing research to make decisions, and collaborating with other Operations Analysts to make recommendations for decision strategy
  • Working closely with department leadership to develop processes and procedures to reach company goals
  • Auditing decisions made by others with a focus on accuracy and efficiency to improve the quality of decisions made on the team
  • Operating as a single contributor on a team with a high level of ownership of individual outcomes

What you should have

  • Experience using a variety of desktop and web-based applications. We use Salesforce, Service Cloud, Slack and Sling here at Gaggle
  • Experience in crisis management, child advocacy, content moderation, or a related field or degree
  • A strong comfort level in communicating sensitive information through email, text, and phone to convey the seriousness of a situation
  • The ability to stay focused on the same task for long uninterrupted periods. You must be able to process large amounts of content quickly and accurately
  • A passion for reading. You will read a lot of material as you review and analyze student content, so excellent reading comprehension is important
  • Confidence to operate independently and autonomously within a virtual team environment and the ability to reach goals with minimal supervision
  • A high degree of ownership of individual outcomes and contribution to the department and company goals.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Python, Typescript) - Full Stack
jobs.excerpt: The Short Version: We aren’t building software to sell ads or optimize clicks.
jobs.description:
The Short Version: We aren’t building software to sell ads or optimize clicks. At Augintel, we build Natural Language Processing (NLP) software that helps social workers and clinicians read through mountains of messy case notes to find critical, life-saving information about kids and families.

Our tool can help a social worker understand a thousand-page case history in seconds. Because of our software, caseworkers are finding lost grandmothers so kids don't go to foster care, uncovering hidden risks, and quickly spotting if a child urgently needs diabetes medication.
We are a small, tight-knit team of five, and we need a Senior Software Engineer to help us build the infrastructure that makes this all possible.

What You Will Actually Do Here: We need you to build the heavy-lifting software around the AI. You will be working closely with a Machine Learning expert.

  • The Heavy Lifting (70%): The biggest chunk of your work will be building the engine that extracts insights from notes and indexes them for downstream consumers (APIs, our web app). This will entail designing and building pipelines that process millions of case notes reliably and at scale. This backend work is heavily driven by Python.
  • The Infrastructure: You will be configuring and using AWS (specifically ECS, OpenSearch, Lambda, and S3) and writing solid SQL (we use PostgreSQL).
  • The Web App (30%): The remaining portion of your work will involve the front-end user interface and APIs, where you will use TypeScript (React and NodeJS).

Who You Are:

  • You have 5+ years of real-world experience. We are looking for someone who is solidly mid-level (your second or third real job). You aren't an entry-level beginner, but you also aren't looking to be a hands-off architect or on a fast track to management. You just want to write great code and improve your craft.
  • You are independent. We are a remote team. We need someone who can work on their couch, figure things out, and know when to raise their hand for help without flailing.
  • You like talking to people. You will occasionally jump on video calls directly with our clients to troubleshoot issues, stand up new features, or whiteboard solutions. We don't want someone who just wants to sit in a dark closet and write code.
  • You want ownership. You won't just be blindly pulling widgets off a backlog. You will collaborate daily with our ML researcher, product manager, and clients to frame problems and design actual solutions.

The Perks:

  • 100% Remote (US-based). If you happen to be in the Chicago area, great—we have a local nexus here—but it is absolutely not required.
  • Get hands-on experience working right alongside cutting-edge Machine Learning and NLP technology.
  • Go to sleep every night knowing your code is actively keeping kids safe and giving social workers their time back.

If you are a solid Python, Typescript and AWS developer who wants to use your powers for good, we want to talk to you.

Overview

Are you ready to make a difference in the world of consumer finance? At Attain Finance, we bring over 50 years of expertise in providing credit solutions across the U.S. and Canada. Our deep roots in the financial industry have empowered us to develop convenient, easily accessible financial services that meet our customers' growing needs.

Join a leading consumer credit lender that thrives on innovation and collaboration, where your contributions are truly valued. Our portfolio includes distinguished brands like Cash Money®, LendDirect® and Heights Finance. Each brand is constantly evolving to better serve our customers.

Be part of a dynamic team that is shaping the future of consumer finance. Apply today and take the next step in your career with Attain Finance!

We're looking for a highly analytical and business-focused Sr. Manager, Digital & Marketing Analytics to lead measurement, reporting, and optimization across our customer acquisition efforts. In this role, you'll help turn complex data into clear insights that drive growth and improve marketing performance across our lending brands.

You'll shape how we measure acquisition effectiveness, identify opportunities throughout the customer journey, develop reporting and analytical models, and provide data-driven recommendations that influence business decisions. You'll partner closely with teams across Marketing, Risk, Finance, Operations, Marketing Technology, and Data Engineering to strengthen our analytics capabilities and support customer growth.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving business problems with data, working across teams, and driving meaningful impact in a fast-paced environment.

Responsibilities

Lead Acquisition Performance Analytics

  • Own acquisition performance reporting and insights across marketing channels.
  • Analyze campaign, funnel, and customer performance to identify growth opportunities.
  • Recommend actions to improve conversion, efficiency, and ROI.

Own Measurement, Tracking & Data Governance

  • Maintain marketing measurement frameworks, KPIs, and tracking standards.
  • Ensure accurate data collection, attribution, and reporting.
  • Partner with Technology and Engineering teams to enhance measurement capabilities.

Develop Attribution & Marketing Effectiveness Models

  • Build and enhance advanced measurement methodologies, including Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM), Multi-Touch Attribution (MTA), incrementality testing, and causal measurement frameworks.
  • Measure performance across channels, campaigns, and customer segments.

Lead Funnel Analytics & Customer Journey Optimization

  • Own end-to-end customer acquisition funnel measurement and analysis.
  • Identify key drop-off points, friction areas, and conversion opportunities throughout the customer journey.
  • Partner with marketing, product, and operations teams to prioritize optimization initiatives and quantify expected business impact.

Drive Experimentation & Insights

  • Design, measure, and evaluate A/B tests, holdout tests, incrementality studies, and other experimentation frameworks.
  • Develop statistically sound approaches for measuring marketing and customer experience improvements.
  • Translate analytical findings into actionable recommendations that influence strategic decisions and business outcomes.

Build Reporting & Analytics Products

  • Develop and maintain scalable dashboards, scorecards, and self-service analytics tools that empower stakeholders across the organization.
  • Deliver executive-ready presentations and insights that clearly communicate performance, opportunities, and recommendations.
  • Continuously evolve reporting capabilities to improve decision-making and operational efficiency.

Support Data Infrastructure & Analytics Enablement

  • Collaborate with Data Engineering to ensure reliable, scalable data pipelines and access to high-quality data.
  • Promote analytics best practices and data-driven decision making across the business.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in quantitative field. Master’s degree preferred.
  • 7+ years of experience in marketing analytics, customer analytics, or performance measurement, preferably within financial services, fintech, consumer lending, or other customer acquisition-driven businesses.
  • Advanced expertise with web analytics and marketing technology platforms such as Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics, ContentSquare, Google Tag Manager, A/B testing platforms (Optimizely, VWO, etc..) or similar technologies, including implementation and governance.
  • Strong understanding of acquisition marketing channels, including paid search, SEO, affiliates, direct mail, email, display, social media, and other performance marketing channels.
  • Expert-level SQL skills with experience querying, transforming, and analyzing large datasets and with data visualization and business intelligence tools (Sigma, Tableau, Looker, Power BI, etc..)
  • Strong analytical skills, including forecasting, segmentation, predictive modeling, and statistical analysis.
  • Demonstrated experience developing or leveraging advanced attribution methodologies, including MMM, MTA, incrementality testing, or causal measurement techniques.
  • Demonstrated experience designing, implementing, and evaluating A/B tests and experimentation programs.
  • Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to translate technical findings into clear business recommendations for executives and non-technical audiences.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, matrixed environment with multiple stakeholders across business functions and geographies.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Working knowledge of Python, R, or comparable analytics/programming languages.
  • Experience applying machine learning or AI-driven approaches to forecasting, propensity modeling, customer segmentation, or marketing optimization is considered an asset.
  • Knowledge of data warehouse architecture, data modeling, and analytics engineering best practices.

Base Salary: $120,000 - $160,000 USD

The base salary range represents the low and high end of the anticipated salary range for this position based on the U.S. average.
